makaleler.baslik: Risk of Distant Metastasis and Oncologic Outcomes of Clinical Near-Complete Responders After Neoadjuvant Therapy in Rectal Cancer: A Meta-Analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Rektum Kanserinde Neoadjuvan Sonrası Yakın-Tam Yanıtlı Hastalarda Onkolojik Sonuçlar: Meta-Analiz
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 10 çalışma ve 1.763 hastayı kapsayan meta-analizde, neoadjuvan tedavi sonrası klinik yakın-tam yanıt veren rektum kanserli hastalar incelendi. Yakın-tam yanıtlılarda uzak metastaz (%16,8'e karşılık %7,3; RR 2,31; p<0,001) ve lokal nüks (%32,8'e karşılık %19,7; RR 1,75; p<0,001) riski yüksek, organ koruma oranı ise düşük (%73,5'e karşılık %80,7) bulundu.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Watch-and-wait has allowed organ preservation in patients with locally advanced rectal cancer who have a clinical complete response to neoadjuvant therapy. The expansion of non-operative management to patients with a near-complete response raises the question of oncological safety in a nonoperative approach in this subset of patients.
OBJECTIVE: We aimed to assess the prognostic impact of clinical response after neoadjuvant therapy and to assess the oncologic safety of nonoperative management in patients with near-complete or complete clinical responses.
DATA SOURCES: We systematically reviewed PubMed, Embase and Web of Science in October 2025 to identify studies comparing oncological outcomes of patients with clinical or near-complete response.
STUDY SELECTION: Studies comparing clinical response after neoadjuvant therapy in patients with locally advanced rectal cancer were included. We excluded conference abstracts.
MAIN OUTCOME MEASURES: Primary outcome was overall survival. Secondary outcomes included distant metastasis, local regrowth, local regrowth-free survival, and organ preservation rate.
RESULTS: We included 10 studies and 1,763 patients. Near-complete response after neoadjuvant therapy for rectal cancer is associated with higher risk of distant metastasis (16.8 vs 7.3%; RR 2.31; 95% CI: 1.63-3.26; p < 0.001; I² = 0%), and local regrowth (32.8 vs 19.7%; RR 1.75; 95% CI: 1.31-2.34; p < 0.001; I² = 42%), as well as reduced organ preservation (73.5 vs 80.7%; RR 0.84; 95% CI: 0.74-0.95; p = 0.007; I² = 69%) compared with clinical complete response. No statistical differences were seen in overall survival (HR 1.43; 95% CI: 0.94-2.16; p = 0.076; I² = 0%).
LIMITATIONS: Heterogeneous definitions of near-complete response and lack of standardized reassessment timing and management.
CONCLUSION: In contrast to individual studies, we found that near-complete response after neoadjuvant therapy may have an increased risk of distant metastasis compared to patients with a complete clinical response.

makaleler.baslik: European Guidelines on Multidisciplinary Management of Obstructed Defecation Syndrome-ESCP, UEG, ESGAR, EAGEN, ESGENA, ESNM and ESPCG.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Obstrükte Defekasyon Sendromunun Multidisipliner Yönetimine İlişkin Avrupa Kılavuzu
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 7 Avrupa derneğinin hazırladığı kılavuzda obstrükte defekasyon sendromunun (ODS) yönetimi için 28 öneri sunuldu. İlk basamakta biofeedback dahil konservatif tedavi önerildi. Cerrahi tedavinin yalnızca konservatif tedaviye yanıt vermeyen ve multidisipliner pelvik taban değerlendirmesi tamamlanan seçilmiş hastalara uygulanması gerektiği vurgulandı.
makaleler.ozet:
INTRODUCTION: The goal of this project was to develop a joint European clinical practice guideline for the diagnosis and treatment of obstructed defecation syndrome (ODS), based on the best available evidence. These guidelines are intended to support all healthcare professionals involved in the care of patients with ODS, such as general practitioners, colorectal surgeons, gastroenterologists, gynecologists, radiologists, physiotherapists, and psychologists, as well as to provide accessible information for patients themselves.
METHODS: A multidisciplinary Guideline Development Group representing seven European scientific societies and including patient representatives formulated PICO-based clinical questions. Evidence was identified through a systematic literature review and assessed using the GRADE approach. Recommendations were formulated according to the available evidence and, where evidence was insufficient, as expert opinions.
RESULTS: The final guideline includes 28 statements (1 moderate grade evidence, 2 low grade evidence, 3 very low grade evidence, 22 expert opinion) covering the diagnosis, conservative and surgical management of ODS, including indications for various imaging modalities, functional tests, and both transanal and transabdominal surgical approaches. Multidisciplinary assessment is recommended throughout the diagnostic and therapeutic pathway. Conservative treatment represents the initial management strategy, with biofeedback recommended before surgery in patients with ODS and dyssynergic defecation who fail dietary and laxative treatment. Surgery should be reserved for selected patients with persistent symptoms after conservative treatment and considered following multidisciplinary pelvic floor evaluation.
CONCLUSION: These multidisciplinary European guidelines offer a comprehensive and evidence-based framework for the diagnosis and management of ODS. They are intended to promote standardized, high-quality care across Europe and to improve outcomes and quality of life for individuals affected by this complex condition. Given the limited quality of evidence supporting many interventions, individualized decision-making within a multidisciplinary setting remains central to ODS management.

makaleler.baslik: Neoadjuvant botensilimab with or without balstilimab in pMMR and dMMR colon cancer: the phase 2 UNICORN trial.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Evre 2 UNICORN Çalışması: Kolon Kanserinde Neoadjuvan Botensilimab ve Balstilimab
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Rezekte edilebilir lokal ileri 56 kolon kanseri hastasında neoadjuvan botensilimab (BOT) tek başına veya balstilimab (BOT+BAL) ile değerlendirildi. pMMR kohortunda pMR oranı BOT ile %0, BOT+BAL ile %36; dMMR kohortunda ise BOT ile %36, BOT+BAL ile %100 saptandı. Ameliyat öncesi ctDNA temizlenmesi patolojik yanıtla korele bulundu.
makaleler.ozet: Preoperative immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) are active in patients with deficient mismatch repair (dMMR) colon cancer (CC), whereas proficient mismatch repair (pMMR) CC has been consistently considered resistant to first-generation ICIs. In the phase 2 UNICORN trial, we evaluated short-course preoperative botensilimab (BOT; multifunctional Fc-enhanced anti-CTLA-4 monoclonal antibody) alone or in combination with the anti-PD-1 monoclonal antibody balstilimab (BOT + BAL) in 56 patients with resectable, locally advanced CC. Twenty-eight patients with pMMR CC were sequentially enrolled in BOT (n = 14) and BOT + BAL (n = 14) cohorts. Twenty-eight patients with dMMR CC followed the same sequential allocation strategy. The primary endpoint of centrally assessed pathological major response (pMR) rate (≤10% of residual viable tumor) was met in all cohorts, except pMMR BOT. Specifically, the pMR rate was 0% (95% confidence interval (CI): 0-23.2%) in pMMR BOT, 36% (95% CI: 12.8-64.9%) in pMMR BOT + BAL, 36% (95% CI: 12.8-64.9%) in dMMR BOT and 100% (95% CI: 76.8-100%) in dMMR BOT + BAL. Secondary endpoints included safety, quality of life, describing treatment-induced transcriptional dynamics, peripheral blood mononuclear cell dynamics, radiomics and radiogenomics features, fecal microbiota composition and circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) dynamics. Eight (29%) and 15 (54%) patients treated with BOT and BOT + BAL, respectively, experienced immune-related adverse events, most commonly flu-like syndrome and diarrhea. Single-cell spatial transcriptomic analysis of matched baseline and post-treatment samples highlighted high baseline PD-L1 stromal expression and low post-treatment regulatory T cell signatures in pMMR responders, whereas dMMR responders displayed high baseline FCGR2A and FCGR3A expression on intratumoral macrophages. Clearance of ctDNA before surgery correlated with pathological response and lack of recurrence at data cutoff. Preoperative BOT + BAL elicits pathological responses in patients with pMMR or dMMR CC, supporting the combination as a promising strategy to expand ICI benefits to the early-stage setting. ClinicalTrials.gov identifier: NCT05845450 .

makaleler.baslik: Estimating the clinical benefit of metastases resection in liver-limited metastatic colorectal cancer: an IPD-based pooled analysis of nine randomized trials.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Karaciğerle Sınırlı Kolorektal Kanser Metastazlarında Rezeksiyonun Klinik Yararı
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 9 randomize çalışmadan alınan 855 hastanın analizinde, karaciğer rezeksiyonu yapılan 357 hastada DFS ile psOS arasında yüksek korelasyon bulundu (ρ=0,73). Erken nüks gelişen rezeke hastalar ile rezeke edilmeyenler arasında OS farkı saptanmazken (HR 0,88, p=0,29), yüksek tümör yükü skoru olanlarda cerrahi eğilimi lehine sonuç izlendi (HR 0,69, p=0,09).
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: In resected liver-limited metastatic colorectal cancer (LL-mCRC), disease-free survival (DFS) and postsurgical overall survival (psOS) have been found to be weakly related in heterogeneous retrospective series, challenging the role of DFS as a surrogate biomarker of psOS. Additionally, it remains unclear whether early relapses (DFS <6 months) are associated with overall survival (OS) benefit.
PATIENTS AND METHODS: We analyzed individual data of patients with LL-mCRC enrolled in nine randomized trials of first-line chemotherapy plus biologics. Correlation and surrogacy between DFS and psOS were calculated with ρ and R2. psOS of resected patients with DFS <6 months was compared with time from minimum disease load (post-min OS) of unresected patients, with stratification according to baseline tumor burden score (TBS). Time on systemic therapy was also evaluated.
RESULTS: Eight hundred fifty-five patients with LL-mCRC were included and 357 (42%) were radically resected. DFS and psOS were highly correlated (ρ = 0.73), with R2 at the patient and trial levels for surrogacy of 0.70 and 0.32, respectively. psOS and post-min OS in resected patients with early relapse (n= 115) and unresected patients (n = 498) were comparable [hazard ratio (HR) 0.88, 95% confidence interval (CI) 0.70-1.11, P = 0.29]. However, a benefit from surgery was detected in patients with high baseline TBS (HR 0.69, 95% CI 0.45-1.05, P = 0.09) but not in patients with low/medium baseline TBS (HR 1.12, 95% CI 0.74-1.69, P = 0.59) (p interaction = 0.10). Resection was associated with a lower percentage of time on systemic therapy (26%) regardless of DFS (47% if <6 months, 26% if ≥6 months) (P < 0.001).
CONCLUSIONS: In LL-mCRC resected after first-line chemotherapy plus biologics, DFS is highly correlated with psOS, with high patient-level surrogacy. In high-burden patients, liver surgery seems associated with a trend toward long-term benefit, also after early relapse (<6 months), whereas time on systemic therapy is reduced.

makaleler.baslik: Long-term (≥ 5 Years) Low Anterior Resection Syndrome and Health Related Quality of Life in Rectal Cancer Patients: A Systematic Review.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Rektum Kanseri Cerrahisi Sonrası Uzun Dönem Düşük Anterior Rezeksiyon Sendromu
makaleler.kisa_ozet: En az 5 yıl takipli 6 çalışma ve 1.000 hastayı içeren sistematik derlemede, hastaların %39,3'ünde majör LARS, %21,5'inde minör LARS görüldü. Majör LARS, sağlıkla ilişkili yaşam kalitesinde belirgin bozulma ile seyretti. Neoadjuvan radyoterapi, kalıcı bağırsak disfonksiyonu için en tutarlı risk faktörü olarak öne çıktı.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Up to 80% of patients who undergo rectal resection suffer from low anterior resection syndrome, with approximately half continuing to experience symptoms more than 10 years after surgery. While short-term outcomes are well documented, evidence on long-term functional and health-related quality of life trajectories remains fragmented. There is some improvement over time, but symptoms often persist.
OBJECTIVE: To systematically review the prevalence, severity, and long-term trajectory of low anterior resection syndrome, and its association with health-related quality of life, in rectal cancer survivors followed for at least five years after sphincter-preserving surgery.
DATA SOURCES: A systematic search of PubMed, Scopus, and the Cochrane Library from inception through September 2025.
STUDY SELECTION: Eligible studies reported low anterior resection syndrome scores in patients at ≥5 years following sphincter-preserving rectal cancer resection. Studies lacking long-term functional assessment or not reporting low anterior resection syndrome were excluded.
INTERVENTIONS: None; all included studies comprised observational cohort data assessing long-term functional outcomes.
MAIN OUTCOME MEASURES: Prevalence of major and minor Low Anterior Resection Syndrome, distribution of long-term low anterior resection syndrome severity categories, and associations between low anterior resection syndrome severity and health-related quality of life measures.
RESULTS: Six studies comprising 1,000 patients were included, with median follow-up ranging from 6.9 to 14.6 years. Across cohorts, major low anterior resection syndrome was reported in 20.5-53.0% of patients and minor low anterior resection syndrome in 14.6-27.0%. Overall, 39.3% of patients experienced major low anterior resection syndrome, 21.5% minor low anterior resection syndrome, and 39.2% reported no low anterior resection syndrome at long-term follow-up. Major low anterior resection syndrome was consistently associated with significant health-related quality of life impairment across multiple domains. Neoadjuvant radiotherapy emerged as the most consistent risk factor for persistent bowel dysfunction.
LIMITATIONS: Heterogeneity in neoadjuvant radiotherapy, tumor height, and exclusion of patients with permanent or secondary stomas; observational designs.
CONCLUSION: Nearly half of rectal cancer survivors experience major Low Anterior Resection Syndrome ≥5 years postoperatively, highlighting the persistence of bowel dysfunction and its lasting impact on health-related quality of life. These findings underscore the need for long-term survivorship care and functional outcome monitoring.

tez.baslik: Kolorektal kanser hayvan modelinde lokorejyonel nüks ile postoperatif diyet arasındaki ilişkinin belirlenmesi
tez.baslik_tr: Kolorektal kanser hayvan modelinde lokorejyonel nüks ve diyet ilişkisi
tez.kisa_ozet: Fare modelinde yapılan bu çalışmada, batı tipi diyet grubunda chow diyet grubuna göre anastomotik ve perianastomotik tümör varlığı anlamlı olarak daha yüksek bulunmuştur (10/11'e karşı 3/11, p=0.008). Batı tipi diyet grubunda histopatolojik tümör yükü skoru, mitoz sayısı ve diferansiyasyon skoru da anlamlı derecede artış göstermiştir.
tez.ozet: Amaç: Kolorektal kanser cerrahisi sonrası lokal/lokorejyonel nüks, cerrahi ve onkolojik tedavilerdeki gelişmelere rağmen önemli bir klinik sorun olmaya devam etmektedir. Anastomoz hattı ve perianastomotik alan, intraluminal tümör hücresi implantasyonu için duyarlı bir yara iyileşme mikroçevresi oluşturabilir. Bu çalışmada, batı tipi diyetin deneysel kolorektal kanser modelinde erken anastomotik/perianastomotik tümör yerleşimi üzerindeki etkisinin değerlendirilmesi amaçlandı. Gereç ve Yöntem: İzogenetik, 8 haftalık erkek BALB/c fareler randomize olarak iki gruba ayrıldı. Deney grubu iki hafta süreyle yağ ve proteinden zengin batı tipi diyetle, kontrol grubu ise liften zengin chow diyetle beslendi. Mekanik ve antibakteriyel bağırsak hazırlığını takiben rektosigmoid kolonda tam kat kesi ve kolorektal anastomoz uygulandı. Postoperatif ikinci günde lavman yoluyla kolon lümenine CT26 fare kolon kanseri hücreleri verilerek cerrahi sırasında lümene dökülen tümör hücreleri taklit edildi. Postoperatif onuncu günde sakrifikasyon yapılarak anastomoz hattı, perianastomotik/perikolonik dokular, mezenterik lenf nodları ve makroskopik patolojik bulgular değerlendirildi. Nihai histopatolojik analizde chow diyet grubunda 11, batı tipi diyet grubunda 11 hayvan yer aldı. Bulgular: Batı tipi diyet grubunda anastomotik/perianastomotik tümör varlığı chow diyet grubuna göre anlamlı olarak daha yüksekti (10/11 ve 3/11; p=0.008). Histopatolojik tümör yükü skoru da batı tipi diyet grubunda anlamlı artış gösterdi (p=0.003). Mitoz sayısı ve diferansiyasyon skoru batı tipi diyet grubunda anlamlı olarak daha yüksek bulundu (sırasıyla p<0001 ve p=0.002). Mezenterik lenf nodu tümör hücresi varlığı, gross anastomotik kaçak, makroskopik apse ve perforasyon batı tipi diyet grubunda sayısal olarak daha fazla izlense de bu farklar istatistiksel anlamlılığa ulaşmadı. Sonuç: Bu deneysel modelde batı tipi diyet, kısa süreli perioperatif maruziyet sonrasında dahi erken anastomotik/perianastomotik tümör yerleşimi ve artmış tümör yükü ile ilişkili bulunmuştur. Bulgular, diyet kompozisyonunun kolorektal anastomoz çevresindeki inflamatuvar ve yara iyileşme mikroçevresini etkileyerek lokal nüks biyolojisinde rol oynayabileceğini düşündürmektedir. Batı tipi diyetten uzaklaşmayı hedefleyen perioperatif beslenme düzenlemelerinin olası koruyucu etkisinin değerlendirilebilmesi için prospektif insan çalışmalarına ihtiyaç vardır. Anahtar Kelimeler: kolorektal kanser, lokorejyonel nüks, anastomotik nüks, batı tipi diyet, CT26, BALB/c

makaleler.baslik: Effectiveness of 5-hydroxytryptamine 3 receptor antagonists in the prevention of postoperative nausea and vomiting after laparoscopic cholecystectomy: A systematic review and network meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Laparoskopik kolesistektomi sonrası PONV için 5-HT3 reseptör antagonistleri
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 2.033 hastayı içeren 21 çalışmalık bir ağ meta-analizinde, palonosetron ve ramosetron laparoskopik kolesistektomi sonrası PONV önlemede en etkili ajanlar olarak bulunmuştur. Ondansetron için 8 mg dozu 4 mg dozundan daha üstün bulunurken, ilaçların operasyon sonunda uygulanması preoperatif uygulamaya göre daha iyi sonuç vermiştir.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Numerous 5-hydroxytryptamine 3 receptor antagonists are available to prevent postoperative nausea and vomiting after laparoscopic cholecystectomy, but relevant comparative data are limited.
AIMS: This study aimed to compare various 5-hydroxytryptamine 3 receptor antagonists in preventing postoperative nausea and vomiting after laparoscopic cholecystectomy via systematic review and network meta-analysis.
METHODS: This study followed the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses statement. We systematically searched for articles in PubMed, Cochrane, Embase, and WOS up to August 2025. The quality of included studies was assessed utilizing the National Institutes of Health Study Quality Assessment Tools. Network meta-analysis was performed to evaluate the effectiveness (risk ratio) of various 5-hydroxytryptamine 3 receptor antagonists, different doses, and usage time of various 5-hydroxytryptamine 3 receptor antagonists in postoperative nausea and vomiting prevention after laparoscopic cholecystectomy. To avoid anomalies in data analysis caused by the absence of postoperative nausea and vomiting, no postoperative nausea and vomiting was analyzed.
RESULTS: A total of 21 studies (n = 2,033 patients) were included. The results revealed that compared with placebo, ramosetron (risk ratio, 2.60) and palonosetron (risk ratio, 2.50) pronouncedly prevented postoperative nausea and vomiting; tropisetron (risk ratio, 0.23), ramosetron (risk ratio, 0.25), and palonosetron (risk ratio, 0.27) significantly prevented nausea; ramosetron (risk ratio, 0.10) markedly prevented vomiting. Ramosetron (risk ratio, 0.43) demonstrated greater efficacy than ondansetron in preventing retching. In subgroup analyses, ondansetron 8 mg outperformed ondansetron 4 mg in preventing nausea, vomiting, and retching. The administration of ondansetron, ramosetron, palonosetron, and granisetron at the end of the operation outperformed preoperative administration in postoperative nausea and vomiting.
CONCLUSION: Among the 5-hydroxytryptamine 3 receptor antagonists, palonosetron and ramosetron show better efficacy in preventing postoperative nausea and vomiting after laparoscopic cholecystectomy. Subgroup analyses show that 8 mg of ondansetron outperforms 4 mg of ondansetron. Administration of drugs at the end of the operation outperforms preoperative administration.

makaleler.baslik: Indocyanine green fluorescence-guided laparoscopic anatomical hepatectomy for radical resection of hepatocellular carcinoma: a clinical study.
makaleler.baslik_tr: HCC rezeksiyonunda ICG floresan kılavuzluğunda laparoskopik anatomik hepatektomi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Rezektabl primer HCC'li 100 hastanın alındığı bir RCT'de, ICG kılavuzluğunda laparoskopik anatomik hepatektomi geleneksel laparoskopiye kıyasla daha yüksek anatomik rezeksiyon (%94'e karşı %58; p<0,001) ve R0 oranları (%100'e karşı %86; p=0,01) sağlamıştır. Ayrıca ICG grubu daha az kan kaybı (217,2 ml'ye karşı 298,44 ml; p=0,002) ve daha az komplikasyon (%18'e karşı %50; p<0,001) göstermiştir.
makaleler.ozet:
INTRODUCTION: Anatomical hepatectomy improves outcomes in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), but remains technically demanding laparoscopically. Indocyanine green (ICG) fluorescence may aid navigation, yet its clinical value remains unproven.
AIM: We aimed to evaluate whether ICG-guided laparoscopic anatomical hepatectomy improved resection quality and short-term outcomes, as compared with conventional high-definition laparoscopy.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: In this single-center, prospective, open-label, parallel-group randomized controlled trial (October 2023-December 2025), 100 patients with resectable primary HCC were randomized at a 1:1 ratio to the ICG-guided laparoscopic anatomical hepatectomy (n = 50) or conventional laparoscopy (n = 50) cohorts. The ICG protocol included preoperative intravenous ICG plus intraoperative ultrasound-guided positive / negative staining. Primary outcomes were anatomical resection and R0 rates. Secondary outcomes included blood loss, complications, 1-year disease-free survival (DFS), and overall survival (OS).
RESULTS: Baseline characteristics of the study population were balanced. Tumor fluorescence and segmental staining were successful in 94% and 98% of the ICG patients, respectively. The ICG group achieved higher anatomical resection (94% vs 58%; P <0.001) and R0 rates (100% vs 86%; P = 0.01), wider margins (mean [SD], 10.27 [3.39] vs 6.97 [4.11] mm; P <0.001), less mean blood loss (217.2 [88.76] vs 298.44 [156.19] ml; P = 0.002), fewer complications (18% vs 50%; P <0.001), and shorter hospital stay (mean, 7.65 [1.68] vs 8.93 [2.84] d; P = 0.008) than the controls. ICG detected additional lesions in 20% of the patients. One-year DFS (88% vs 75.04%) and OS (93.82% vs 91.49%; P = 0.8) were similar in both groups. Adjusted recurrence hazard ratio was 2.146 (95% CI, 0.932-4.938; P = 0.07).
CONCLUSIONS: ICG fluorescence-guided laparoscopic anatomical hepatectomy is safe and feasible, significantly improving radical resection quality with more anatomical dissections, higher R0 rates, wider margins, and fewer complications, as compared with the conventional approach. Longer follow-up is needed to confirm survival benefits.

makaleler.baslik: Preoperative Contrast-Enhanced CT-Based Three-Dimensional Fractal Analysis of Automatically Segmented Tumors for Predicting PD-L1 Expression in Hepatocellular Carcinoma: A Preliminary Study.
makaleler.baslik_tr: HCC'de PD-L1 ekspresyonunu tahmin etmek için preoperatif CT tabanlı fraktal analiz
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 134 HCC hastasının dahil olduğu retrospektif çalışmada, preoperatif CECT görüntülerinden elde edilen 3 boyutlu fraktal özelliklerin ve RVI'nın PD-L1 pozitifliğini öngörebildiği gösterilmiştir. Geliştirilen kombine model validasyon kohortunda 0,813 AUC değeri ile iyi bir öngörü performansı göstermiştir.
makaleler.ozet:
OBJECTIVES: To evaluate whether 3-dimensional fractal features extracted from automatically segmented hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) tumor volumes on preoperative contrast-enhanced CT (CECT) can predict programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) expression.
METHODS: This retrospective study included patients with pathologically confirmed HCC between January 2022 and March 2026 who underwent multiphasic liver CECT and PD-L1 immunohistochemical staining of surgical or biopsy tumor specimens. PD-L1 positivity was defined as a combined positive score ≥1. Patients were randomly divided into training and validation cohorts. Tumor VOIs were automatically segmented on portal venous phase CECT using the uAI Research Portal. Three-dimensional fractal dimension (FD3D) and 3-dimensional lacunarity (Lac3D) were extracted using the box-counting method. LASSO logistic regression was used to select predictors of PD-L1 positivity and to build a combined model.
RESULTS: A total of 134 patients with HCC were included, of whom 69 had PD-L1-positive tumors, and 65 had PD-L1-negative tumors. Patients were randomly assigned to the training cohort (n=87; 44 PD-L1-positive) and validation cohort (n=47; 25 PD-L1-positive). In both cohorts, tumor FD3D and Lac3D were significantly higher in PD-L1-positive patients than in PD-L1-negative patients (both P<0.05). LASSO-logistic regression identified FD3D, Lac3D, and radiologic venous invasion (RVI) as predictors of PD-L1 positivity. The combined model incorporating these variables showed good predictive performance in the validation cohort, with an AUC value of 0.813. Calibration curves and decision curve analysis demonstrated good model calibration and clinical net benefit.
CONCLUSION: Tumor 3-dimensional fractal features derived from preoperative CECT can quantitatively reflect the spatial structural complexity and heterogeneity of HCC. A combined model integrating FD3D, Lac3D, and RVI may facilitate noninvasive preoperative prediction of PD-L1 expression and serve as an imaging biomarker for characterizing tumor immune-related features.

makaleler.baslik: Impact of Laparoscopic Liver Resection on Long-Term Outcomes and Non-Liver-Related Mortality in Elderly Patients With Primary Hepatocellular Carcinoma: A Multicenter Propensity Score-Matched Analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Yaşlı HCC hastalarında laparoskopik karaciğer rezeksiyonunun uzun dönem sonuçları
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 969 hastanın dahil olduğu çok merkezli PSM analizinde, laparoskopik karaciğer rezeksiyonunun (LLR) açık rezeksiyona kıyasla daha az kan kaybı, daha az komplikasyon ve daha kısa hastanede kalış süresi sağladığı görülmüştür. 80 yaş ve üzeri soliter HCC hastalarında LLR, diğer kanserler dışındaki karaciğer dışı ölüm riskini anlamlı düzeyde azaltmıştır.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Elderly patients with hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) are increasingly undergoing hepatectomy. Although laparoscopic liver resection (LLR) has been shown to provide better short-term outcomes than open liver resection (OLR), long-term outcomes are generally considered comparable. However, the impact of surgical approach on cause-specific death, particularly non-liver-related death, remains unclear in elderly patients.
METHODS: This multicenter retrospective study included 969 patients ≥ 65 years old who underwent curative hepatectomy for solitary primary HCC ≤ 5 cm in maximum diameter at 18 institutions between 2010 and 2018. Propensity score matching was performed to reduce selection bias. Short- and long-term outcomes, including liver-related and non-liver-related death, were compared between LLR and OLR. Subgroup analyses were conducted according to age group.
RESULTS: After matching, LLR was significantly associated with lower blood loss, fewer postoperative complications, and shorter hospital stay than OLR. In the entire cohort, overall survival did not differ between groups. Among non-liver-related deaths, respiratory disease-related death was more frequent in the OLR group. Among patients ≥ 80 years old, the incidence of non-liver-related death excluding death from other cancers was significantly lower in the LLR group, even after propensity score matching.
CONCLUSIONS: LLR may reduce the risk of non-liver-related death excluding death from other cancers in patients ≥ 80 years old with solitary HCC ≤ 5 cm in maximum diameter. When determining surgical strategies in elderly patients, it is important to consider long-term systemic outcomes in addition to oncological factors. In patients for whom LLR is technically feasible, its minimally invasive nature may provide clinical benefits.

makaleler.baslik: Age Does Not Affect Textbook Outcome After Liver Surgery Within an Enhanced Recovery Pathway.
makaleler.baslik_tr: ERAS protokolü altında yaşın karaciğer cerrahisinde Textbook Outcome'a etkisi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 618 hastanın incelendiği retrospektif kohort çalışmasında, yaşlı yetişkinler ile genç hastalar arasında Textbook Outcome (TOLS) oranlarının benzer olduğu saptanmıştır (%56'ya karşı %58, p=0,78). ERAS protokolü dahilinde tek başına yaşın optimal bir postoperatif süreci engellemediği, cerrahi karmaşıklık ve perioperatif faktörlerin daha kritik belirleyiciler olduğu gösterilmiştir.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Textbook outcome in liver surgery (TOLS) is a novel comprehensive quality metric reflecting an ideal postoperative course. Data on TOLS in older adult patients remain limited. This study aimed to compare TOLS achievement between older adults and younger patients and to identify TOLS predictors.
METHODS: A retrospective cohort study including all consecutive patients undergoing elective liver surgery within an enhanced recovery (ERAS) program (2013-2023) was conducted. Older adult patients were defined as ≥ 70 years. TOLS achievement was based on international consensus criteria. TOLS predictors were assessed using multivariable logistic regression.
RESULTS: A total of 618 patients were included, of whom 179 (29%) were ≥ 70 years. Overall, 354 patients (57%) achieved TOLS. TOLS rates were similar in older adults and younger patients (56% vs. 58%, p = 0.78). TOLS predictors were higher ERAS compliance (OR 1.1, p < 0.01), minor hepatectomy (OR 2.0, p < 0.01), absence of biliary anastomosis (OR 0.4, p < 0.01), preoperative biliary stenting (OR 0.2, p < 0.01), and absence of intraoperative blood transfusion (OR 0.2, p < 0.01). Age was not associated with TOLS (OR 1.0, p = 0.10).
CONCLUSION: TOLS rates were comparable in older adults and younger patients. Within an ERAS pathway, age alone does not compromise the likelihood of achieving an optimal postoperative course. Surgical complexity and perioperative factors appear to be more critical determinants of TOLS.

tez.baslik: Laparoskopık kolesistektomi yapılan hastalarda ameliyat öncesi ve ameliyattan bir ay sonra serum elektrolitleri, nötrofil-lenfosit oranı ve trombosit-lenfosit oranlarının karşılaştırılması
tez.baslik_tr: Laparoskopik kolesistektomide NLR, PLR ve laboratuvar değişimleri
tez.kisa_ozet: Safra taşı nedeniyle laparoskopik kolesistektomi yapılan 529 hastada yapılan çalışmada, akut kolesistit grubunda preoperatif NLR ve nötrofil sayısı anlamlı yüksek saptandı. Ameliyat sonrası 1. günde geçici sistemik inflamatuvar yanıt ve enzim yükselmeleri görülürken, 1. ayda tüm parametrelerin normale döndüğü görüldü.
tez.ozet: Amaç: Semptomatik safra taşı hastalığı ve akut kolesistit, cerrahi pratiğinde en sık karşılaşılan ve erken müdahale edilmediğinde morbiditesi yüksek olabilen acil durumlardandır. Bu çalışmanın temel amacı, laparoskopik kolesistektomi(LC) uygulanan hastalarda preoperatif Nötrofil-Lenfosit Oranı (NLR) ve Trombosit-Lenfosit Oranı (PLR) gibi parametrelerin hastalığın şiddetini öngörmedeki prediktif değerini belirlemek ve cerrahi stres ile karbondioksit pnömoperitonyumunun erken (postoperatif 1. gün) ve geç (postoperatif 1. ay) dönem laboratuvar bulguları üzerindeki dinamik etkilerini incelemektir. Gereç ve Yöntem: Çalışmaya, kliniğimizde safra taşı hastalığı nedeniyle lc uygulanan toplam 529 hasta dahil edilmiştir (yaş ortalaması 54,36; %64,08 kadın). Hastaların 491'i kronik kolesistit, 38'i ise akut kolesistit tanısı alarak opere edilmiştir. Olguların preoperatif, postoperatif 1. gün ve 1. ay tam kan sayımı, karaciğer fonksiyon testleri (KCFT) ve biyokimyasal parametreleri analiz edilmiştir. vi Bulgular: Preoperatif değerlendirmede, akut kolesistit grubunda NLR, nötrofil sayısı ve KCFT seviyeleri kronik kolesistit grubuna göre istatistiksel olarak anlamlı düzeyde yüksek bulunmuştur. Postoperatif 1. günde, cerrahi travma ve artmış intraabdominal basınca sekonder gelişen geçici splanik hipoperfüzyonun etkisiyle her iki grupta da lökositoz, NLR ve PLR'de dramatik bir sıçrama ile aspartate aminotransferaz(AST) ve alanin aminotransferaz(ALT) enzimlerinde belirgin yükseliş izlenmiştir. Aynı dönemde endotelyal geçirgenlik artışına (kapiller kaçış) bağlı olarak albümin ve kalsiyum(Ca) düzeylerinde anlamlı düşüş saptanmıştır. Postoperatif 1. ay kontrollerinde ise, akut grupta kısmi yüksekliği devam eden PLR ve bazı kolestaz enzimleri haricinde, tüm inflamatuvar ve hepatik parametrelerin preoperatif bazal seviyelerine dönerek normalleştiği tespit edilmiştir. Sonuç: Rutin ve düşük maliyetli kan sayımından elde edilen NLR ve PLR, akut kolesistitin şiddetini öngörmede klinisyene yol gösteren güçlü biyobelirteçlerdir. Laparoskopik kolesistektomi, postoperatif ilk 24 saatte masif bir sistemik inflamatuvar yanıt ve geçici hepatoselüler disfonksiyon yaratsa da; bu fizyolojik stres tablosu birinci ayın sonunda kalıcı bir hasar bırakmaksızın tam bir hücresel homeostaz ve restitüsyon ile sonuçlanmaktadır.

makaleler.baslik: Effect of pancreatic neck transection site on postoperative complications after laparoscopic pancreaticoduodenectomy: a multicenter randomized controlled trial.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Laparoskopik Pankreatikoduodenektomide Pankreas Boyun Kesi Yerinin Komplikasyonlara Etkisi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 141 hastanın dahil olduğu çok merkezli bu RCT'de, genişletilmiş pankreas boyun kesisi (EPNT) grubunda klinik olarak anlamlı postoperatif pankreatik fistül (CR-POPF) insidansı %10,9 iken, konvansiyonel kesi (CPNT) grubunda %26,0 saptanmıştır (RR=0,42; %95 CI 0,19-0,93; P=0,031). EPNT ayrıca enfeksiyöz komplikasyonları da anlamlı derecede azaltmıştır.
makaleler.ozet:
AIM/BACKGROUND: Theoretical controversy persists regarding the optimal pancreatic neck transection site during laparoscopic pancreaticoduodenectomy (LPD). This study aimed to investigate the impact of pancreatic neck transection level on postoperative complications after LPD.
METHODS: This multicenter, open-label, randomized controlled trial was conducted at four high-volume pancreatic surgery centers in China. Patients scheduled for LPD were randomly assigned to undergo pancreatic neck transection at different sites. In the extended pancreatic neck transection (EPNT) group, transection was performed 5-10 mm lateral to the left margin of the superior mesenteric vein-portal vein (SMV-PV) axis. While in the conventional pancreatic neck transection (CPNT) group, transection was carried out anterior to the SMV-PV axis. The primary outcome measure was the incidence of clinically relevant postoperative pancreatic fistula (CR-POPF), and analyses were performed based on the modified intention-to-treat (mITT) analysis.
RESULTS: Among 152 eligible patients, 141 were randomized and included in the mITT analysis. Sixty four patients were allocated to the EPNT group and 77 to the CPNT group. The incidence of CR-POPF was 10.9% in the EPNT group versus 26.0% in the CPNT group (RR = 0.42, 95%CI 0.19-0.93, P = 0.031). Additionally, the EPNT group exhibited a significantly lower incidence of infectious complications compared with the CPNT group (10.9% vs. 26.0%, P = 0.031). No statistically significant intergroup differences were detected with respect to other perioperative complications (P > 0.05).
CONCLUSION: Compared with CPNT, EPNT significantly reduces the incidences of CR-POPF and infectious complications following LPD without elevating the risk of other complications.
TRIAL REGISTRATION NUMBER: NCT05808894.

makaleler.baslik: Immunochemotherapy for Borderline Resectable or Locally Advanced Pancreatic Cancer: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Borderline Reseke Edilebilir veya Lokal İlerlemiş Pankreas Kanserinde İmmünokemoterapi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 392 hastanın alındığı evre II RCT'de, modifiye FOLFIRINOX'a toripalimab eklenmesi kemoterapiye kıyasla olaysız sağkalımı anlamlı düzeyde iyileştirmiştir (ortanca 11,1 aya karşı 9,6 ay; HR 0,74; %95 CI 0,60 ila 0,92; P=0,007). Ortanca genel sağkalım ise 20,6 aya karşılık 17,1 ay olarak gerçekleşmiştir.
makaleler.ozet:
PURPOSE: The optimal treatment strategy for patients with borderline resectable pancreatic cancer (BRPC) and locally advanced pancreatic cancer (LAPC) remains undefined. We evaluated whether the addition of programmed cell death protein 1 blockade to modified FOLFIRINOX improves outcomes compared with modified FOLFIRINOX alone.
METHODS: In this open-label, randomized phase II trial, patients with histologically confirmed BRPC or LAPC were randomly assigned (1:1) to receive modified FOLFIRINOX plus toripalimab (immunochemotherapy) or modified FOLFIRINOX alone (chemotherapy). Treatment response was assessed every 2 months, and surgical eligibility was determined by a multidisciplinary team. The primary end point was event-free survival (EFS) in the intention-to-treat population.
RESULTS: Between April 2019 and March 2025, 392 patients were randomly assigned to immunochemotherapy (n = 196) or chemotherapy (n = 196). After a median follow-up of 39.6 months, immunochemotherapy significantly improved EFS compared with chemotherapy (median, 11.1 v 9.6 months; hazard ratio [HR], 0.74 [95% CI, 0.60 to 0.92]; P = .007). The median overall survival (OS) was 20.6 versus 17.1 months (HR, 0.81; 95% CI, 0.63 to 1.03). Objective response rates were 30.1% (59/196) and 18.9% (37/196), respectively. Tumor resection rates were 42.3% (83/196) and 43.9% (86/196), and R0 resection rates were 84.1% (69/82) and 74.7% (62/83), respectively. Prespecified subgroup analyses suggested improved EFS and OS in BRPC but not LAPC. Grade 3 or higher adverse events occurred in 47.9% (93/194) and 49.2% (96/195) of patients receiving immunochemotherapy and chemotherapy, respectively. Grade III or higher postoperative complications occurred in 30.1% (25/83) and 25.6% (22/86) of resected patients.
CONCLUSION: The addition of PD-1 blockade to modified FOLFIRINOX significantly improved EFS without increasing treatment-related toxicity or surgical morbidity in patients with BRPC or LAPC.

makaleler.baslik: Impact of perioperative corticosteroids on postoperative morbidity after pancreaticoduodenectomy: A systematic review, meta-analysis, and trial sequential analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Pankreatikoduodenektomi Sonrası Perioperatif Kortikosteroidlerin Morbiditeye Etkisi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 397 hastayı içeren 3 RCT'nin birincil analizinde, perioperatif kortikosteroid kullanımı mortalitede anlamlı azalma sağlamamıştır (risk farkı -0,00; %95 CI -0,03 ila 0,03). Klinik olarak anlamlı postoperatif pankreatik fistül ise kortikosteroid grubunda anlamlı derecede azalmıştır (risk farkı -0,09; %95 CI -0,17 ila -0,01; NNT 11).
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Postoperative morbidity after pancreaticoduodenectomy remains clinically relevant despite improvements in perioperative care and surgical technique. Perioperative systemic corticosteroids have been proposed to attenuate the inflammatory response after pancreatic surgery, but the certainty of the randomized evidence remains unclear.
METHODS: We performed a systematic review, meta-analysis, and trial sequential analysis of randomized controlled trials evaluating perioperative systemic corticosteroids in adults undergoing pancreaticoduodenectomy. Eligible studies compared hydrocortisone, dexamethasone, or analogous systemic corticosteroids with placebo, no corticosteroids, or active pharmacologic comparators; trials with a placebo or no-treatment control constituted the primary analysis, and the trial with an active pharmacologic comparator was included in a sensitivity analysis. The main outcomes were mortality, major morbidity, and clinically relevant postoperative pancreatic fistula. Secondary outcomes included postpancreatectomy hemorrhage, delayed gastric emptying, reoperation, readmission, corticosteroid-related adverse events, and length of hospital stay. Trial sequential analysis was performed under a range of prespecified anticipated effects, and the certainty of the evidence for the critical outcomes was rated using Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development, and Evaluation.
RESULTS: Three randomized controlled trials with a placebo or no-treatment control (397 patients) constituted the primary analysis; a fourth trial with an active comparator (pasireotide) was added in a sensitivity analysis, for a total of 4 randomized controlled trials and 454 patients. Corticosteroid use was not associated with a significant reduction in mortality (primary analysis: risk difference, -0.00; 95% confidence interval, -0.03 to 0.03; sensitivity analysis: risk difference, -0.01; 95% confidence interval, -0.03 to 0.02). Major morbidity was numerically lower with corticosteroids, but the difference was not statistically significant (risk difference, -0.04; 95% confidence interval, -0.11 to 0.02 in both analyses). Clinically relevant postoperative pancreatic fistula was significantly reduced with corticosteroids (primary analysis: risk difference, -0.09; 95% confidence interval, -0.17 to -0.01; number needed to treat, 11; sensitivity analysis: risk difference, -0.08; 95% confidence interval, -0.16 to 0.00; number needed to treat, 12). Trial sequential analysis showed that the required information size was not reached for any of the critical end points under any prespecified anticipated effect (20%-30% relative risk reduction) or under the observed effect, in either analysis, suggesting that the current evidence remains underpowered. No significant differences were observed for delayed gastric emptying, postpancreatectomy hemorrhage, readmission, or length of stay in the primary analysis, whereas reoperation (risk difference, -0.04; 95% confidence interval, -0.08 to -0.01; number needed to treat, 23) was less frequent in the corticosteroid group. No trial reported an increase in corticosteroid-related adverse events (infections, hyperglycemia) with corticosteroids compared with controls.
CONCLUSION: Perioperative systemic corticosteroids may reduce the incidence of clinically relevant postoperative pancreatic fistula after pancreaticoduodenectomy, but the certainty of the randomized evidence is low to moderate, and the current data are insufficient to support their routine clinical use.

makaleler.baslik: Metro-Pancreas Stratifies Survival After Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy and Surgery for Resectable Pancreatic Cancer.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Neoadjuvan Tedavi Alan Rezeke Edilebilir Pankreas Kanserinde Metro-Pancreas Sınıflaması
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Neoadjuvan kemoterapi ve rezeksiyon uygulanan 623 hastanın incelendiği çalışmada, tanı anında Metro-Pancreas OUT olan 263 hastanın (%42,2) postoperatif hastalıksız sağkalımı (13,3 aya karşı 16,7 ay; P=0,003) ve genel sağkalımı (29,5 aya karşı 34,8 ay; P=0,006) daha kısa bulunmuştur. Tedavi sonrasında yeniden evrelemede prognostik ayrım daha belirgin hale gelmiştir.
makaleler.ozet:
OBJECTIVE: To assess the prognostic utility of the Metro-Pancreas framework in resectable pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) treated with neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NAT) and resection.
SUMMARY BACKGROUND DATA: Upfront surgery and NAT are options in anatomically resectable PDAC. Metro-Pancreas combines tumor size and CA 19-9 to stratify prognosis after upfront resection, but its applicability after NAT is unknown.
METHODS: We analyzed 623 patients with nonmetastatic, anatomically resectable PDAC who underwent NAT followed by resection from 5 institutions (2016-2024). Metro-Pancreas classification (IN/OUT) was determined by tumor size and CA19-9 levels. Treatment response followed NCCN 2026 definition based on radiologic and biochemical changes. Postoperative disease-free survival (DFS) and overall survival (OS) were evaluated.
RESULTS: At diagnosis, 263 patients (42.2%) were Metro-Pancreas OUT and had shorter postoperative DFS (13.3 vs. 16.7 mo; P=0.003) and OS (29.5 vs. 34.8 mo; P=0.006) than Metro-Pancreas IN patients. After NAT, 71.9% of OUT patients were reclassified as IN, while 5.0% of initially IN patients became OUT. Among baseline OUT patients, 35.7% had significant response, 46.0% had minimal response, and 18.3% had progression. Prognostic separation was greater at Metro-Pancreas restaging (DFS: 7.7 vs. 17.3 mo; OS: 15.8 vs. 36.7 mo; both P=0.001). Patients reclassified from OUT to IN had postoperative DFS and OS comparable to those initially IN (P=0.806 and P=0.631, respectively).
CONCLUSIONS: Among patients undergoing resection after NAT, Metro-Pancreas stratified prognosis at diagnosis and more effectively at restaging. Reclassification from OUT to IN was associated with favorable postoperative survival, supporting dynamic prognostic reassessment in the neoadjuvant setting.

makaleler.baslik: Preoperative endoscopic ultrasound (EUS) strain elastography for the prediction of intraoperative pancreatic texture after pancreaticoduodenectomy: a prospective diagnostic accuracy study with exploratory analysis of clinically relevant postoperative pancreatic fistula.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Pankreatikoduodenektomi Öncesi EUS Elastografi ile Pankreas Dokusunun Değerlendirilmesi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Seçmeli pankreatikoduodenektomi yapılan 100 ardışık hastada yapılan bu prospektif çalışmada, preoperatif EUS strain oranı (SR) kesme değeri ≤2,5 ile yumuşak doku tahmini için duyarlılık %87,9, özgüllük %83,3 ve AUC 0,91 (%95 CI 0,84-0,96) olarak saptanmıştır. SR değeri, histolojik fibrozis derecesi ile güçlü bir şekilde korelasyon göstermiştir.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Postoperative pancreatic fistula (POPF) is the most serious complication of pancreaticoduodenectomy (PD); established risk tools require intraoperative variables. We assessed the diagnostic accuracy of preoperative endoscopic ultrasound (EUS) strain elastography for intraoperative pancreatic texture and, exploratorily, predictors of clinically relevant POPF (CR-POPF).
METHODS: Prospective single-centre study of 100 consecutive patients undergoing elective PD. The index test was preoperative EUS strain ratio (SR), threshold ≤ 2.5 prespecified before enrolment; the reference standard was intraoperative texture recorded independently by two blinded surgeons, with neck-margin fibrosis grade as secondary reference. CR-POPF (ISGPS 2016 Grade B/C) was adjudicated blind to EUS. Accuracy is reported with Wilson 95% confidence intervals (CIs). An exploratory index used Firth-penalised regression restricted to preoperative variables, with bootstrap validation. Reporting follows STARD, TRIPOD, and STROBE.
RESULTS: Soft texture occurred in 58 (58%). SR ≤ 2.5 gave 51 true positives, 7 false positives, 7 false negatives, 35 true negatives: sensitivity 87.9% (95% CI 77.1-94.0), specificity 83.3% (69.4-91.7), predictive values 87.9 and 83.3%, accuracy 86.0% (77.9-91.5), and area under the curve (AUC) 0.91 (0.84-0.96). SR rose monotonically with fibrosis grade (2.0 ± 0.6 to 5.8 ± 1.9; Spearman ρ = +0.82, p < 0.001); mean histogram elasticity fell (ρ = - 0.79, p < 0.001). CR-POPF occurred in 16 (16%). Non-PDAC pathology was unassociated with CR-POPF (9/48 vs 7/52; odds ratio 1.48, 0.51-4.35; p = 0.59). Six preoperative variables were entered simultaneously (EUS-SR, duct diameter, albumin, haemoglobin, body mass index, serum amylase; amylase carried zero points in the rounded score). Apparent AUC was 0.87 (0.79-0.94), optimism-corrected 0.78, calibration slope 0.72, and Brier score 0.096.
CONCLUSIONS: Preoperative EUS strain elastography at a prespecified threshold identified intraoperative pancreatic texture accurately and tracked histological fibrosis, supporting it as an objective surrogate for parenchymal consistency. The index rests on 16 events, is hypothesis-generating, and requires external multicentre validation.

tez.baslik: Karsinogenezde etkin bir biyobelirteç olan Pfetin`in pankreas adenokarsinomlu hastalarda prognoz üzerine etkisi ve bilinen biyobelirteçler ile karşılaştırılması
tez.kisa_ozet: Pankreas adenokarsinomu tanısıyla ameliyat edilen 23, ameliyat edilemeyen 23 hasta ve 20 sağlıklı birey incelendi. Hastalarda Pfetin mRNA düzeyleri sağlıklı erişkinlere göre anlamlı yüksek saptanırken (p=0,002), nüks ve sağkalım ile anlamlı ilişki bulunamadı.
tez.ozet: Amaç: Pankreas adenokarsinomunda sıklıkla ileri evrede tanı alması, agresif biyolojik davranışı ve tedaviye sınırlı yanıtı nedeniyle tedavi sonrası hastalığın erken nüksü sık görülür, bu sebeple de sağkalım beklentisi kısadır. Bu çalışmada, KCTD12 (Pfetin'in) pankreas adenokarsinomlu hastalarda periferik kandaki mRNA ekspresyonu ve serum protein düzeyinin erken nüksü öngörmedeki etkinliğinin araştırılması amaçlanmışdır. Gereç ve Yöntem: Bu çalışmaya, İstanbul Üniversitesi İstanbul Tıp Fakültesi Genel Cerrahi Anabilim Dalı'nda 1 Ocak 2021–1 Nisan 2025 yılları arasında pankreas adenokarsinomu tanısı alan, küratif amaçlı ameliyat edilen 23 hasta, rezektabl olmadığı için ameliyat edilemeyen 23 hasta ve kontrol amaçlı 20 sağlıklı kişi dahil edildi. KCTD12 (Pfetin) protein düzeyleri ELISA yöntemi ile, mRNA ekspresyon düzeyleri ise gerçek zamanlı PCR yöntemi ile değerlendirildi. Pfetin düzeyleri ile klinikopatolojik değişkenler, CA19-9 düzeyi, tümör boyutu, lenf nodu tutulumu, nüks ve sağkalım arasındaki ilişkiler analiz edildi. Pfetin mRNA ekspresyonunun tanısal performansı "Receiver Operating Characteristic" (ROC) analizi ile incelendi. Bulgular: Cerrahi uygulanan 23 hastanın 17'sine pankreatikoduodenektomi, 6'sına distal pankreatektomi yapıldı. Ameliyat edilemeyen 23 hastanın 18'i sistemik kemoterapi ve 5'i ise kemoradyoterapi ile tedavi edildi. Hastalarda Pfetin mRNA ΔCt düzeyi sağlıklı erişkinlere oranla anlamlı derecede yüksek saptandı (p=0,002). Pfetin mRNA ekspresyonu ile CA19-9 arasında korelasyon saptanmadı (r=-0,127; p=0,4). Tümör boyutu ≥3 cm olan hastalarda Pfetin mRNA düzeyleri (p=0,03), lenf nodu pozitifliği bulunan hastalarda ise Pfetin protein düzeyleri anlamlı düzeyde yüksek bulundu (p=0,002). Buna karşın Pfetin düzeyleri ile nüks ve sağkalım arasında anlamlı ilişki saptanmadı. Sonuç: KCTD12 (Pfetin)'nin pankreas adenokarsinomunda yüksek olmasının tanısal potansiyel taşıyabileceği ve tümör boyutu ile lenf nodu tutulumu gibi tümör progresyonunu yansıtan parametrelerle ile ilişkili olduğu ancak nüks ve sağkalımı öngörmede anlamlı olmadığı saptandı. CA19-9 ile anlamlı korelasyon saptanmaması, Pfetin'in farklı biyolojik süreçleri yansıtan tamamlayıcı bir biyobelirteç olabileceğini düşündürmektedir. Anahtar Kelimeler: KCTD12, CA19-9, tümör mikroçevresi, kemoresistans, sıvı biyopsi.
tez.dergi_tam: İSTANBUL ÜNİVERSİTESİ / TIP FAKÜLTESİ / GENEL CERRAHİ ANABİLİM DALI

makaleler.baslik: Robotic versus laparoscopic gastrectomy for gastric cancer: 5-year long-term results from a randomized controlled trial.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Mide Kanserinde Robotik ve Laparoskopik Gastrektomi: 5 Yıllık Sonuçlar
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Resektabl mide kanserli 241 hastayı içeren bir faz III RCT'de, laparoskopik ve robotik gastrektomi arasında 5 yıllık relapse-free survival (%69'a karşı %75) ve overall survival (%71'e karşı %79) açısından anlamlı fark saptanmamıştır. Erkek alt grubunda robotik grupta overall survival daha iyi bulunmuştur (HR 0,48; %95 CI 0,25-0,95).
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Despite increasing global adoption of robotic approaches, the comparative effectiveness of robotic gastrectomy versus laparoscopic gastrectomy for gastric cancer is uncertain, particularly regarding long-term oncologic outcomes.
METHODS: This phase III randomized controlled trial (RCT) enrolled 241 patients with resectable gastric cancer (clinical stages I-III) between April 1, 2018, and October 31, 2020. Patients were randomly assigned to undergo either robotic gastrectomy or laparoscopic gastrectomy. The primary endpoint was postoperative intra-abdominal infectious complications (previously reported). Secondary endpoints included long-term oncologic outcomes, specifically relapse-free survival, overall survival and patterns of recurrence.
RESULTS: This study enrolled 241 patients, with 236 patients in the modified intention-to-treat population. The 5-year relapse-free survival in the modified intention-to-treat population did not significantly differ between the laparoscopic gastrectomy and robotic gastrectomy groups (69% vs. 75%). Similarly, overall survival was not significantly different between the groups (71% vs. 79%). The 5-year cumulative incidence of primary disease-specific death was comparable between the groups (16.1% vs. 11.6%). Patterns of recurrence did not differ between them. In subgroup analyses, the robotic gastrectomy group demonstrated significantly better overall survival than the laparoscopic gastrectomy group among male patients (HR, 0.48; 95% CI, 0.25-0.95). Among patients that underwent distal gastrectomy, the robotic gastrectomy group showed a significantly lower cumulative incidence of primary disease-specific death than the laparoscopic gastrectomy group (HR, 0.24; 95% CI, 0.07-0.81).
CONCLUSION: In this RCT, secondary endpoint analyses showed no statistically significant differences in 5-year relapse-free survival or overall survival between laparoscopic gastrectomy and robotic gastrectomy.

makaleler.baslik: Robotic-assisted versus conventional minimally invasive esophagectomy after neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Neoadjuvan Kemoradyoterapi Sonrası RAMIE ve CMIE Karşılaştırması
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Neoadjuvan kemoradyoterapi sonrası özofajektomi yapılan 2.395 hastayı (609 RAMIE, 1.786 CMIE) içeren 7 çalışmanın meta-analizinde, RAMIE grubunda tahmini kan kaybı daha düşük (MD -26,44 mL, %95 CI -34,36 ila -18,51; p < 0,001) ve lenf nodu verimi daha yüksek (MD 2,60, %95 CI 1,81-3,38; p < 0,001) bulunmuştur.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Robotic-assisted minimally invasive esophagectomy (RAMIE) is increasingly used as an alternative to conventional minimally invasive esophagectomy (CMIE). However, many prior comparisons include mixed patient populations and variable neoadjuvant treatment strategies. Because neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy (nCRT) can make esophagectomy technically more difficult, the relative performance of RAMIE in this specific setting remains uncertain.
METHODS: We performed a systematic review and meta-analysis using Nested Knowledge AutoLit to compare RAMIE and CMIE among patients undergoing esophagectomy after predominantly nCRT-based treatment. Eligible studies directly compared the two operative approaches and reported perioperative, surgical, or oncologic outcomes. Effect estimates were pooled with random-effects models. Odds ratios (ORs) were used for dichotomous outcomes, and mean differences (MDs) were used for continuous outcomes. Analyses were performed in R version 4.5.2 using the meta package. Risk of bias was assessed with ROBINS-I.
RESULTS: Seven studies including 2,395 patients were analyzed; 609 patients underwent RAMIE and 1,786 underwent CMIE. Compared with CMIE, RAMIE was associated with lower estimated blood loss (MD -26.44 mL, 95% CI -34.36 to -18.51; p < 0.001), shorter hospital length of stay (MD -1.78 days, 95% CI -3.41 to -0.15; p = 0.032), and higher lymph node yield (MD 2.60 nodes, 95% CI 1.81-3.38; p < 0.001). No significant differences were identified for pathologic complete response, R0 resection, overall postoperative complications, anastomotic leak, 30-day mortality, or 90-day mortality.
CONCLUSIONS: Among patients undergoing esophagectomy after predominantly nCRT-based treatment, RAMIE was associated with lower blood loss, shorter hospital stay, and higher lymph node yield compared with CMIE, without significant differences in oncologic outcomes, postoperative morbidity, or short-term mortality. These findings suggest that RAMIE is a safe and effective minimally invasive approach in this population, although interpretation is limited by the observational design of the included studies.

makaleler.baslik: Operative efficiency and perioperative safety of overlap versus π-shaped esophagojejunostomy after totally laparoscopic total gastrectomy for gastric cancer: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Overlap ve Pi-Shaped Esofajojejunostominin Karşılaştırılması
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Tam laparoskopik total gastrektomi sonrası overlap ile pi-shaped rekonstrüksiyonu karşılaştıran 13 çalışmanın (1.246 hasta) meta-analizinde, pi-shaped yöntemin toplam ameliyat süresini ve anstomoz süresini azalttığı, ancak anstomoz kaçağı veya komplikasyon oranlarında belirgin üstünlük sağlamadığı gösterilmiştir.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Overlap and π-shaped esophagojejunostomy are common linear-stapled reconstructions after totally laparoscopic total gastrectomy (TLTG), but whether the technical time advantage of one method is accompanied by better perioperative safety remains uncertain. This study aimed to compare the two techniques in terms of operative efficiency, recovery, and anastomotic complications.
METHODS: In an unfunded PROSPERO-registered meta-analysis (PROSPERO registration: CRD420261398884), PubMed/MEDLINE, Web of Science, Scopus, Cochrane CENTRAL, China National Knowledge Infrastructure (CNKI), and Wanfang were searched from inception through 29 July 2026 without language restriction. Randomized and non-randomized comparative studies of adults undergoing curative TLTG with overlap versus π-shaped reconstruction were eligible. Random-effects mean differences (MDs) and risk ratios (RRs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were pooled. Risk of bias was assessed with RoB 2 or ROBINS-I and certainty with GRADE.
RESULTS: Thirteen studies (1,246 patients; one reported-randomized study and 12 retrospective cohorts) were included; 10 studies (982 patients) contributed to at least one meta-analysis. Compared with π-shaped reconstruction, overlap required longer total operative time (8 studies, 826 patients; MD 17.37 minutes, 95% CI: 7.67 to 27.06; I2=66.1%) and anastomosis time (8 studies, 718 patients; MD 7.61 minutes, 95% CI: 5.84 to 9.38; I2=67.6%). No clear differences were found in anastomotic leakage (9 studies, 880 patients; RR 0.76, 95% CI: 0.41 to 1.43), stenosis/stricture (RR 0.48, 95% CI: 0.12 to 1.82), any early postoperative complication (7 studies, 671 patients; RR 0.90, 95% CI: 0.66 to 1.24), blood loss, recovery, pulmonary infection, or reflux esophagitis. Most non-randomized studies had serious risk of bias; certainty was low for anastomosis time and very low for the remaining major outcomes.
CONCLUSIONS: π-shaped reconstruction may reduce operative and anastomosis times, but the available evidence does not establish superiority in safety or recovery. Technique selection should remain individualized until prospective multicenter comparisons with standardized outcomes are available.

makaleler.baslik: Perioperative safety profile of robotic versus laparoscopic hiatal hernia repair: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Robotik ve Laparoskopik Hiatal Herni Onarımının Perioperatif Güvenliği
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 696.886 hastayı içeren 11 karşılaştırmalı çalışmanın meta-analizinde, robotik (RHHR) ve laparoskopik (LHHR) hiatal herni onarımı arasında genel komplikasyonlar açısından fark bulunmazken (OR 1,14; %95 CI 0,98-1,33), robotikte intraoperatif komplikasyonlar daha az (OR 0,42; %95 CI 0,24-0,73) ve hastane kalışı daha kısa (MD -0,40 gün) bulunmuştur; buna karşılık kardiyopulmoner olaylar, 30 günlük yeniden yatış ve mortalite robotikte daha yüksek saptanmıştır.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Robotic hiatal hernia repair (RHHR) is increasingly used, but whether its technical advantages improve perioperative safety compared with laparoscopic hiatal hernia repair (LHHR) remains uncertain. We compared the short-term safety profiles of RHHR and LHHR, with particular attention to organ-specific postoperative complications.
METHODS: MEDLINE (via PubMed), Web of Science, Embase, and the Cochrane Library were searched from inception through 15 July 2025 for comparative studies of RHHR and LHHR in adults. Study selection and data extraction were performed independently by two reviewers. The primary outcome was overall postoperative complications; secondary outcomes included cardiovascular, respiratory, and urological complications, dysphagia, operative time, intraoperative complications, 30-day readmission, mortality, and length of stay. Risk of bias was assessed using the Newcastle-Ottawa Scale for cohort studies, and certainty of evidence was evaluated using GRADE. Odds ratios (ORs) and mean differences (MDs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were pooled as appropriate.
RESULTS: Eleven comparative studies (10 retrospective and one prospective) involving 696,886 patients were included. Overall postoperative complications did not differ significantly between RHHR and LHHR (OR 1.14, 95% CI 0.98-1.33). RHHR was associated with fewer intraoperative complications (OR 0.42, 95% CI 0.24-0.73) and a modestly shorter hospital stay (MD -0.40 days, 95% CI -0.78--0.02). In contrast, RHHR was associated with higher odds of cardiovascular events (OR 1.24, 95% CI 1.17-1.31), respiratory complications (OR 1.65, 95% CI 1.59-1.71), 30-day readmission (OR 1.23, 95% CI 1.19-1.27), and mortality (OR 1.26, 95% CI 1.11-1.43). No significant differences were observed for urological complications, postoperative dysphagia, or overall operative time. Certainty of evidence ranged from low to very low.
CONCLUSIONS: Comparative evidence identified through 15 July 2025 suggests broadly similar overall postoperative morbidity after RHHR and LHHR. RHHR may be associated with fewer intraoperative complications and a shorter hospital stay, but observed associations with higher odds of cardiopulmonary events, readmission, and mortality should be interpreted cautiously because the evidence is predominantly observational and susceptible to residual confounding, case-mix differences, and database-related bias.

makaleler.baslik: State-of-the-art treatment of Oesophagogastric junction adenocarcinoma: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized clinical trials.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Özofagogastrik Bileşke Adenokarsinomunda Güncel Tedavi Yaklaşımları
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 13.000'den fazla hastayı kapsayan 100 RCT'nin incelendiği meta-analizde, cerrahinin küratif tedavinin temel taşı olduğu, minimal invaziv tekniklerin, perioperatif kemoterapi ve kemoimmünoterapinin standart yaklaşımlar olarak yerini koruduğu belirtilmiştir. Özofagogastrik bileşke adenokarsinomunun tümör lokalizasyonuna göre farklı etkinlik gösteren ayrı bir hastalık olarak ele alınması gerektiği vurgulanmıştır.
makaleler.ozet: Oesophagogastric junction adenocarcinoma (OGJ AC) represents an increasingly prevalent malignancy for which treatment recommendations remain challenging, as patients are frequently included within trials addressing gastric or oesophageal cancer. We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized clinical trials (RCTs) published between 2000 and 2025 including patients with OGJ AC to provide a comprehensive assessment of contemporary treatment strategies for this disease across all stages. A total of 100 high-quality RCTs including more than 13,000 patients with OGJ tumours were identified. In localized disease, 36 studies evaluated surgical procedures, adjuvant/neoadjuvant/perioperative treatments and definitive approaches. Surgery is still the cornerstone of curative treatment, increasingly incorporating minimally invasive techniques. Perioperative chemotherapy and chemoimmunotherapy represent standard approaches, while neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy followed by adjuvant nivolumab represents an alternative strategy. In advanced disease, 64 studies assessed systemic therapies in first/second/third lines or palliative interventions. Platinum-fluoropyrimidine chemotherapy persists as the backbone of first-line treatment, with treatment intensification guided by biomarkers. While the benefit of trastuzumab in HER2-positive tumours appears greater in OGJ than in gastric cancer, the opposite pattern is observed with zolbetuximab in CLDN18.2-positive tumours. Several trials testing anti-PD-1 therapies confirm their activity in OGJ AC, despite the predictive value of PD-L1 appearing uncertain in this anatomical subgroup. In later lines, paclitaxel plus ramucirumab, trastuzumab deruxtecan for HER2-positive disease, and trifluridine-tipiracil remain established options. The available evidence suggests clinically meaningful differences in treatment efficacy according to tumour location, supporting the consideration of OGJ AC as a distinct disease entity. Dedicated OGJ AC trials incorporating standardized anatomical classification are needed to improve outcomes in this aggressive disease.

tez.baslik: Özofagus kanserinde neoadjuvan tedavi yanıtı: Klinik ve patolojik tam yanıtın değerlendirilmesi
tez.baslik_tr: Özofagus Kanserinde Neoadjuvan Tedavi Yanıtı ve Tam Yanıtın Değerlendirilmesi
tez.kisa_ozet: 122 hastanın incelendiği bu tek merkezli çalışmada patolojik tam yanıt (pCR) oranı %44 bulunmuştur. BT/MR ve endoskopi kombinasyonunun yüksek özgüllüğe (%93,4) ancak düşük duyarlılığa (%43,8) sahip olduğu, cCR'nin pCR'nin bağımsız belirleyicisi olduğu ve pCR'nin nüksü önlemede koruyucu faktör olduğu gösterilmiştir.
tez.ozet: Amaç: Lokal ileri evre özofagus kanserinde neoadjuvan tedavi sonrası klinik (cCR) ve patolojik tam yanıtın (pCR) uyumunu incelemek, pCR'yi ve cCR'yi öngören faktörleri saptamak ve nüks ile genel sağkalıma etki eden bağımsız prognostik faktörleri değerlendirmektir. Gereç ve Yöntem: Temmuz 2020–Şubat 2026 arasında neoadjuvan tedavi almış 122 hasta tek merkezli ve retrospektif olarak incelendi; tanısal performans ve sağkalım analizleri özofajektomi uygulanan 109 hasta üzerinden yapıldı. pCR ve nüks için Firth penalize lojistik regresyon, prognoz için penalize Cox regresyon ve Kaplan-Meier yöntemi kullanıldı. Bulgular: Çalışma grubumuzda pCR oranı %44 bulundu. Hastaların çoğunluğunu skuamöz hücreli karsinom oluşturdu. BT/MR ve endoskopinin kombine değerlendirilmesiyle ortaya çıkan cCR, yöntemler arasında pCR ile en yüksek uyumu gösterdi (κ=0,392; duyarlılık %43,8, özgüllük %93,4, doğruluk %71,6). BT/MR (%31,2; %96,7) ve endoskopi (%37,5; %86,9) yüksek özgüllüğe karşın düşük duyarlılık sergiledi. Çok değişkenli analizlerde cCR (yaklaşık 11 kat), BT/MR yanıtı, endoskopik yanıt ve preoperatif albümin pCR'nin bağımsız belirleyicileriydi; adenokarsinom histolojisi ve FLOT rejimi düşük pCR ile ilişkiliydi. Nüks oranı %12,3 idi. Tek değişkenli analizde sigara kullanımı, cN3 evresi, pT3, pozitif cerrahi sınır ve lenfovasküler invazyon nüksle ilişkiliydi; pCR ise bağımsız koruyucu faktördü. Genel sağkalımda patolojik T ve N evresi, lenfovasküler ve perinöral invazyon, cerrahi sınır pozitifliği, downstaging, pCR ve tümör regresyon derecesi anlamlı prognostik faktörlerdi. Sonuç: BT/MR, endoskopi ve cCR'nin yüksek özgüllükleri pCR'yi doğrulamada değerli olsa da düşük duyarlılıkları aktif sürveyansı güvenle yönlendirmeye yetersizdir. EUS-FNA eklenmesi ve preSANO/SANO modeline uygun çok modaliteli yanıt değerlendirmesi gereklidir. Bu bulgular hastaya özgü tedavi kararları için referans oluşturabilir. Anahtar Kelimeler: Özofagus kanseri, neoadjuvan kemoradyoterapi, patolojik tam yanıt, klinik tam yanıt, aktif sürveyans
