makaleler.baslik: Total Small Bowel Length and Limb-length Decision-making in Metabolic and Bariatric Surgery for Asian Populations: An APMBSS 2026 Modified Delphi Expert Consensus Statement.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Asyalı Popülasyonda Total İnce Bağırsak Uzunluğu ve Lim Uzunluğu
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Asya popülasyonunda metabolik ve bariatrik cerrahide total ince bağırsak uzunluğu ve lim uzunlukları için Delphi konsensusu yapıldı. Uzmanlar standart ölçüm ve dokümantasyonu desteklerken, evrensel bir lim formülü üzerinde uzlaşmadı.
makaleler.ozet:
INTRODUCTION: Total small bowel length (TSBL) varies substantially and may modify the physiological effect of intestinal bypass in metabolic and bariatric surgery (MBS). Fixed limb lengths do not account for individual variation and may contribute to suboptimal metabolic effect or excessive malabsorption.
METHODS: The APMBSS 2026 TSBL Consensus Panel used a two-round modified Delphi process. Faculty rated 38 statements across seven domains on a 5-point Likert scale. Thirty-five statements reached consensus in Round 1 and were reaffirmed during faculty review at the congress without repeat scoring; only three were revised and revoted. Consensus required a median score of at least 4 and at least 80% of ratings at 4 or 5; strong consensus required at least 90% agreement.
RESULTS: Forty-one analyzable responses from 15 countries/regions were included in Round 1. Thirty-five statements reached consensus. Three statements were discussed, revised, and revoted; one additional statement reached consensus. Overall, 36 of 38 statements achieved consensus (30 strong, 6 consensus). No final consensus was reached on routine TSBL measurement during standard sleeve gastrectomy or on diminishing metabolic returns beyond a 150-cm biliopancreatic limb in Roux-en-Y gastric bypass.
CONCLUSION: The consensus supports standardized measurement and documentation of TSBL and procedure-specific limb lengths in bypass-based procedures. It does not prescribe a universal limb-length formula, but establishes a framework for interpreting bypass physiology, balancing metabolic efficacy and nutritional safety, and evaluating TSBL-adjusted strategies in Asian registries and prospective studies.
KEY POINTS: • TSBL provides an anatomical denominator for interpreting intestinal bypass. • Standardized TSBL and limb-length documentation was supported by the panel. • No universal TSBL-adjusted limb-length formula was supported. • The panel supported a minimum 300-cm common channel for SADI-S in Asian populations.

makaleler.baslik: Cardiovascular and diabetes outcomes after metabolic bariatric surgery versus obesity management medications: nationwide overlap-weighted cohort study of 379 858 patients.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Metabolik Bariatrik Cerrahi ve Obezite İlaçlarının Kardiyovasküler ve Diyabet Sonuçları
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 379858 hastayı içeren ulusal kohort çalışmasında MBS, obezite ilaçlarına kıyasla 1. yılda daha yüksek %TWL (%25,4'e karşı %6,4) ve glisemik normalleşme sağlarken, 5 yıllık nefropati, retinopati, MACE ve mortalite risklerini düşürdü (HR sırasıyla 0,55, 0,60, 0,78 ve 0,61).
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Metabolic bariatric surgery (MBS) and incretin-based therapy (IBT) are effective treatments for obesity and type 2 diabetes (T2D). However, their comparative effectiveness in current practice remains incompletely defined.
METHODS: Adults aged ≥18 years with obesity and T2D who underwent MBS or initiated obesity management medications (OMMs) were identified. The median follow-up was 4.9 (interquartile range (i.q.r.) 3.6-6.7) years for MBS and 4.3 (i.q.r. 3.4-5.8) years for IBT. Overlap weighting balanced baseline covariates between groups. Five-year outcomes included nephropathy, retinopathy, major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE), and all-cause mortality. One-year outcomes included percentage total weight loss (%TWL) and rates of haemoglobin A1c (HbA1c) <6.5%.
RESULTS: In total, 379 858 adults met the inclusion criteria (32 401 underwent MBS and 347 457 initiated OMMs). After overlap weighting, baseline covariates were well balanced. Compared with OMMs, MBS was associated with lower 5-year cumulative incidences of nephropathy (4.5% versus 8.3%; -3.8% points; HR 0.55 (95% c.i. 0.52 to 0.60)), retinopathy (3.6% versus 7.4%; -3.8% points; HR 0.60 (95% c.i. 0.55 to 0.65)), MACE (6.1% versus 8.1%; -2.0% points; HR 0.78 (95% c.i. 0.73 to 0.84)), and all-cause mortality (2.1% versus 3.7%; -1.6% points; HR 0.61 (95% c.i. 0.55 to 0.69)). At 1 year, the mean %TWL was greater after MBS (25.4% (95% c.i. 25.3% to 25.5%)) than after OMMs (6.4% (95% c.i. 6.3% to 6.5%)). Among patients with baseline HbA1c ≥6.5%, the proportion achieving HbA1c <6.5% at 1 year was higher after MBS (76.7% (95% c.i. 75.3% to 78.0%)) than after OMMs (47.2% (95% c.i. 46.2% to 48.1%); P < 0.001). Findings were consistent across agent-stratified, competing-risk, landmark, and no-censoring sensitivity analyses.
CONCLUSION: Among adults with obesity and T2D, MBS was associated with greater %TWL, higher glycaemic normalization, and lower 5-year risks of nephropathy, retinopathy, MACE, and all-cause mortality compared with real-world initiation of OMMs among patients in clinical equipoise, supporting the role of MBS as a durable therapy in multimodal obesity management.

makaleler.baslik: The Efficacy of Ultrasound-Guided Thoracic Erector Spinae Plane Block for Perioperative Analgesia During Laparoscopic Bariatric Surgery in Super-Obese Patients: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Süper Obezlerde Laparoskopik Bariatrik Cerrahide Erektor Spinae Plane Blok
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 60 süper obez hastada yapılan RCT'de, bilateral ultrason eşliğinde torasik ESPB, ilk 24 saatlik morfin eşdeğeri tüketimini azalttı (11 mg'a karşı 24,5 mg; p<0,001) ve erken mobilizasyonu kolaylaştırdı.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Super-obese patients undergoing laparoscopic bariatric surgery are at an increased risk of opioid-related respiratory compromise, underscoring the need for opioid-sparing analgesia.
OBJECTIVES: To compare bilateral ultrasound-guided thoracic erector spinae plane block (ESPB) and trocar-site local anesthetic infiltration with respect to perioperative opioid consumption and early postoperative pain.
METHODS: In this single-center randomized controlled trial, 60 adults aged 18 - 60 years with American Society of Anesthesiologists physical status III and a Body Mass Index (BMI) > 50 kg/m2 who were scheduled for laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy or Roux-en-Y gastric bypass were randomized 1:1 to receive bilateral T7 ESPB with 0.25% bupivacaine (30 mL/side) or trocar-site infiltration with 0.5% bupivacaine (5 mL/site). The primary outcome was cumulative perioperative opioid consumption during the first 24 hours, expressed as an intravenous morphine-equivalent dose. Secondary outcomes included intraoperative fentanyl use, Visual Analog Scale pain scores at rest and during coughing, time to first rescue analgesia, time to ambulation, hemodynamics, the 15-item Quality of Recovery (15-item Quality of Recovery questionnaire (QoR-15)) score at 24 hours, and complications.
RESULTS: ESPB reduced intraoperative fentanyl requirements (56.7% vs 100%; total dose, 50 [25 - 75] vs 100 [100 - 212.5] µg; both P < 0.001) and cumulative 24-hour morphine-equivalent consumption (11 [9.75 - 13] vs 24.5 [22 - 33], mg; P < 0.001). Visual analog scale scores were lower with ESPB at rest at 4 and 8 hours and during coughing within the first 8 hours (all P < 0.001). Erector spinae plane block prolonged the time to first rescue analgesia (8 [8 - 12] vs 4 [4 - 8], h) and enabled earlier ambulation (4.07 ± 0.78 vs 4.60 ± 0.67 h; both P < 0.001). The QoR-15 score was higher with ESPB (118.8 ± 5.35 vs 106.6 ± 3.91; P < 0.001).
CONCLUSIONS: In super-obese patients, thoracic ESPB provided a clinically meaningful opioid-sparing effect, improved early pain control and quality of recovery, and facilitated earlier mobilization following laparoscopic bariatric surgery.

makaleler.baslik: Erector spinae plane block in bariatric surgery: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials with trial sequence analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Bariatrik Cerrahide Erector Spinae Plane Blok
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 613 hastayı içeren 9 RCT'lik meta-analizde, ESP blok operasyon sonrası ilk 24 saatte opioid tüketimini ortalama 36,94 mg azaltmıştır (95% CI -60,85 ila -13,03, p=0,009). İlk analjezi talebi süresi uzamış, ağrı skorları düşmüştür.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: The use of erector spinae plane (ESP) block has been reported to decrease opioid requirements for patients undergoing bariatric and metabolic surgeries (BMS). We aim to systematically review and examine the evidence for the use of ESP block in BMS.
METHODS: MEDLINE, Embase, Scopus, and CENTRAL electronic databases were searched for all studies on ESP block in BMS from database inception through 21st July 2025. Two reviewers independently assessed and selected studies, collected data, assessed the risk of bias and quality of evidence. The primary outcome for this review is opioid consumption in 24 h post-operation. Secondary outcomes include intraoperative opioid consumption, time to first request for analgesia, and postoperative pain scores.
RESULTS: Nine randomised control trials involving 613 patients were found to be eligible. ESP block significantly reduced opioid consumption in the first 24 h after surgery, with a mean oral morphine equivalent daily dose (oMMED) reduction of 36.94 mg (95% CI -60.85 to -13.03, p = 0.009, I2 = 94%). Trial sequential analysis (TSA) suggests a potential benefit of ESP block though this interpretation is limited by marked statistical heterogeneity. Time to first request for analgesia was significantly prolonged with ESP block. Intraoperative opioid requirements, time to first request for analgesia, and postoperative reported pain scores were reduced in the ESP block group.
CONCLUSIONS: Current evidence suggests that the bilateral ultrasound-guided ESP block may be a practical technique to improve perioperative pain control and reduce opioid usage in patients undergoing BMS. However, these findings must be interpreted with caution due to the very low to moderate certainty of evidence and high clinical heterogeneity.

makaleler.baslik: Effect of immunosuppressive agents on bariatric surgery: a systematic review.
makaleler.baslik_tr: İmmünsüpresif Ajanların Bariatrik Cerrahiye Etkisi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 33 çalışmayı içeren sistematik derlemede, immünsüpresif ajanların bariatrik cerrahi sonrası daha yüksek komplikasyon oranlarıyla ilişkili olduğu, ancak kilo kaybı ve metabolik iyileşmelerin literatürle tutarlı kaldığı gösterildi.
makaleler.ozet: Bariatric surgery is a well-established treatment for obesity and its associated co-morbidities. The impact of immunosuppressive therapy on patients undergoing bariatric surgery remains poorly understood although it has been associated with higher infection rates, poor wound healing, and anastomotic leakage. Evidence on the effect of immunosuppressive agents on bariatric surgery is warranted to optimize patient care and surgical success. We aimed to evaluate the impact of immunosuppressive agents on weight loss outcomes and complication rates after common bariatric procedures. A systematic review was conducted across PubMed, Google Scholar, Medline, and Embase since December 2013 using keywords related to immunosuppressive agents and bariatric surgery to select primary, peer-reviewed studies for analysis. Thirty-three studies met inclusion criteria. Immunosuppressive agents analyzed included corticosteroids, disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs, biologic agents, and calcineurin inhibitors across various bariatric procedures. Immunosuppressive conditions consisted of inflammatory bowel disease in 3 studies, solid organ transplant in 21 studies, rheumatoid arthritis in 3 studies, systemic lupus erythematosum in 1 study, and 6 studies with an unspecified immunosuppressive agent, most commonly corticosteroids. Immunosuppressive agents were associated with higher postoperative complication rates after bariatric surgery; however, weight loss outcomes and metabolic improvements remained consistent with established literature. Sleeve gastrectomy (SG) is safe in immunosuppressed patients; however, consideration of individual patient profile is important in procedural planning and selection. Large-scale prospective research is required to substantiate the evidence for procedural selection and the effects of individual immunosuppressive agents.

tez.baslik: Morbid obezite nedeniyle sleeve gastrektomi yapılan hastalarda serum apolipoprotein düzeylerinin kilo kaybı ile ilişkisi
tez.baslik_tr: Sleeve Gastrektomi Hastalarında Apolipoproteinler ve Kilo Kaybı
tez.kisa_ozet: 76 morbid obez hastanın incelendiği prospektif çalışmada, preoperatif Apo CII düzeyinin %EWL (Beta=-0,02, p<0,001) ve %TWL (Beta=-0,01, p<0,001) üzerinde negatif prediktör olduğu saptanmıştır. Preoperatif Apo CII, CIII ve düşük Apo D düzeyleri dirençli profili öngörmektedir.
tez.ozet: Amaç: Bu çalışmanın amacı, morbid obezite nedeniyle Laparoskopik Sleeve Gastrektomi (LSG) uygulanan hastaların preoperatif dönemdeki serum apolipoprotein (Apo AI, AII, B100, CII, CIII, D, E, E4, H, J ve M) düzeylerinin, postoperatif 12. aydaki kilo kaybı (%EWL ve %TWL) üzerindeki prediktif değerini araştırmaktır. Gereç ve Yöntem: Prospektif kohort tasarımı olan çalışmaya, bariatrik cerrahi endikasyonu ile LSG uygulanan 76 morbid obez hasta dahil edilmiştir. Hastaların preoperatif rutin biyokimyasal ve apolipoprotein profilleri analiz edilmiş; operasyon öncesi ve postoperatif 12. aydaki vücut ağırlığı ve vücut kompozisyonları biyoelektrik empedans analizi (BIA) yöntemiyle ölçülmüştür. Cerrahi başarı, fazla kilo kaybı yüzdesi (%EWL) ve toplam kilo kaybı yüzdesi (%TWL) üzerinden hesaplanarak, preoperatif parametrelerin etkileri tek ve çok değişkenli regresyon analizleriyle değerlendirilmiştir. Bulgular: Çok değişkenli analiz modelleri sonucunda, preoperatif Apo CII düzeyinin postoperatif birinci yıl %EWL (Beta=-0.02, p<0.001) ve %TWL (Beta=-0.01, p<0.001) başarıları üzerinde istatistiksel olarak bağımsız bir negatif prediktör olduğu saptanmıştır. Ayrıca, postoperatif kas kütlesi değişimi ile preoperatif Apo CIII seviyesi arasında negatif yönde (r=-0.24, p=0.037), Apo D seviyesi ile ise pozitif yönde (r=0.27, p=0.019) anlamlı korelasyon bulunmuştur. Çok değişkenli modelde preoperatif VKİ ve HDL düzeyleri de %EWL başarısı üzerinde bağımsız negatif prediktörler olarak belirlenmiştir. Sonuç: Spesifik apolipoproteinlerin (yüksek Apo CII, Apo CIII ve düşük Apo D) preoperatif profillemesi, dirençli profile sahip veya sarkopeni riski taşıyan hastaların önceden tespitini sağlamaktadır. Bu olgularda kısıtlayıcı yöntemler yerine kombine cerrahi prosedürlere yönelmek daha uygun bir strateji sunmaktadır.

makaleler.baslik: Primary Endocrine Therapy vs Upfront Surgery for Older Women With Estrogen Receptor-Positive Breast Cancer: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Yaşlı Meme Kanserinde Primer Endokrin Tedavi ve Cerrahi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 22821 hastayı içeren 29 çalışmanın meta-analizinde, primer endokrin tedavi ile cerrahi arasında OS açısından istatistiksel olarak anlamlı bir fark bulunmadı (HR 1,14; %95 CI 0,98-1,33). Bulgular, uygun hastalarda tümör biyolojisi ve frailty temel alınabileceğini desteklemektedir.
makaleler.ozet:
IMPORTANCE: As the population of older women with breast cancer grows, an increasing number are considered for primary endocrine therapy (pET), yet clinicians lack a framework for identifying which patients are appropriate candidates, resulting in reliance on chronologic age and life expectancy rather than tumor biology.
OBJECTIVE: To evaluate survival and variables associated with response duration for patients treated with pET.
DATA SOURCES: PubMed, MEDLINE, Web of Science, and Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials were searched from inception through March 26, 2026.
STUDY SELECTION: Randomized clinical trials (RCTs) and non-RCT (observational) cohorts comparing pET with surgery in operable, nonmetastatic, estrogen receptor (ER)-positive breast cancer.
DATA EXTRACTION AND SYNTHESIS: Data were extracted independently by 2 reviewers per Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses guidelines. Hazard ratios (HRs) not directly reported were reconstructed from Kaplan-Meier curves. Randomized clinical trial-derived HRs for overall survival (OS) and breast cancer-specific survival (BCSS) were pooled using a random-effects model, given anticipated heterogeneity across trials spanning 5 decades and differing tumor biology criteria. Observational cohorts were analyzed descriptively, not pooled for comparative survival, given susceptibility to confounding by indication.
MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: The main outcomes were OS and BCSS (RCTs) assessed using meta-analysis. Time to progression, salvage intervention rates, and variables associated with progression and mortality (observational cohorts) were assessed using descriptive analyses.
RESULTS: Twenty-nine studies (6 RCTs and 23 observational cohorts; 22 821 patients; overall median [IQR] age, 83.1 [77.0-85.0] years) met the inclusion criteria. Patients from RCTs were generally younger (median [IQR] age, 77.0 [75.8-78.0] years) than those from the observational studies (median [IQR] age, 84.0 [81.5-86.0] years). Treatment with pET was not associated with a statistically significant OS difference vs surgery (HR, 1.14; 95% CI, 0.98-1.33), though the point estimate favored surgery. Median time to progression ranged from 19.7 months (range, 13.5-26.0 months) in tumor biology-unselected, tamoxifen-era cohorts to more than 50 months in ER-selected and aromatase inhibitor-treated cohorts. Tumor biology was consistently associated with progression risk.
CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: This systematic review and meta-analysis of more than 22 000 patients with ER-positive breast cancer found no statistically significant survival difference between pET and upfront surgery. Durable disease control under pET seemed to be concentrated in patients with favorable biology. These findings support a framework incorporating tumor biology and frailty, rather than age alone, to identify candidates for pET.

makaleler.baslik: Added Value of Preoperative Contrast Enhanced Mammography in Staging of Malignant Breast Lesions (PROCEM): A Randomized Controlled Trial.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Meme Kanserinde Preoperatif Kontrastlı Mamografi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 415 hastanın dahil olduğu RCT'de, preoperatif kontrastlı mamografi %10 tedavi değişikliğine ulaşarak birincil son noktayı karşılamadı, ancak malign lezyon boyutunu tahmin etmede doğruluğu artırdı. Mastektomi (%17'ye karşı %18; p=0,78) veya reoperasyon oranlarında fark görülmedi.
makaleler.ozet: Background Contrast-enhanced mammography (CEM) is increasingly used in breast cancer diagnostics; however, randomized trials assessing the added value of CEM in preoperative staging of breast cancer beyond digital mammography, digital breast tomosynthesis, and US are lacking. Purpose To assess the added value of CEM for preoperative breast cancer staging in a randomized controlled trial. Materials and Methods This prospective randomized controlled trial (Added Value of Preoperative Contrast Enhanced Mammography in Staging of Malignant Breast Lesions) enrolled women diagnosed with early-stage breast cancer eligible for primary surgery at two breast centers in Sweden. Participants were randomized 1:1 to preoperative CEM or control from November 2020 through April 2024. The primary outcome was a 10% change in treatment due to preoperative CEM findings. Secondary outcomes included differences in reoperation and mastectomy rates between groups and accuracy of malignant extent estimation with CEM, mammography/tomosynthesis, and US using histopathologic extent as the reference, assessed with Bland-Altman statistics and concordance analysis. Subgroup analyses were performed according to menopausal status, breast density, histopathologic type of cancer, lesion size, and presence of microcalcifications at baseline imaging. Results In total, 415 participants (median age, 66 years; IQR, 56-73 years) completed the trial: 202 in the CEM group and 213 in the control group. Treatment was changed in 17 of 202 participants (8.4%; 95% CI: 5.3, 13.1) based on CEM findings. No evidence of differences was observed between the CEM and control groups with regard to mastectomy (17% [35 of 202] vs 18% [39 of 213]; P = .78) or reoperation (7.9% [16 of 202] vs 10% [22 of 213]; P = .39) rates. CEM showed the closest agreement with histopathologic malignant extent (bias, 3.5 mm), outperforming mammography and/or tomosynthesis (4.8 mm) and US (10.7 mm) overall and in nine of 10 predefined subgroups, except for ductal carcinoma in situ. Conclusion This trial did not meet its primary end point of a 10% treatment change; however, preoperative CEM improved malignant extent estimation. makaleler.baslik: Impact of rhomboid intercostal plane block on chronic pain incidence and acute pain scores after oncologic breast surgery: a randomized controlled trial.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Romboid İnterkostal Blok ve Kronik Ağrı
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 254 hastanın alındığı RCT'de, preoperatif romboid interkostal blok (RIB) kronik ağrı insidansını 3. ayda (%17'ye karşı %31; p=0,009) ve 6. ayda (%13'e karşı %30; p<0,001) anlamlı düzeyde azalttı. Ayrıca RIB grubu 24 saatlik opioid tüketiminde düşüş gösterdi (p=0,01).
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Persistent chronic pain after oncologic breast surgery remains a major clinical problem, affecting approximately 25-60% of patients and significantly impairing quality of life. Although the rhomboid intercostal plane block (RIB) has been shown to reduce acute postoperative pain, its role in preventing chronic postoperative pain remains inadequately investigated.
METHODS: This prospective, single-center, randomized, double-blind, controlled trial included 254 adult women undergoing oncologic breast surgery with or without lymph node dissection. Patients were randomized to receive either a pre-operative ultrasound-guided single-shot RIB using 30 mL of 0.25% bupivacaine or no regional block (control group). All patients received standardized multimodal systemic analgesia. The primary outcome was the incidence of chronic pain at 3 months postoperatively. Secondary outcomes included chronic pain at 6 months, Brief Pain Inventory-Short Form scores at 3 and 6 months, neuropathic pain assessed using the Douleur Neuropathique 4 questionnaire, acute postoperative pain scores, and 24-h postoperative opioid consumption.
RESULTS: Of the 254 randomized patients, 247 completed the study. Chronic pain incidence was significantly lower in the RIB group at 3 months (17% vs 31%; p = 0.009) and 6 months (13% vs 30%; p < 0.001), with reduced neuropathic pain at 6 months. The RIB group had lower 24-h opioid consumption than controls (p = 0.01).
CONCLUSIONS: Pre-operative single-shot RIB significantly reduced chronic postoperative pain and opioid consumption following oncologic breast surgery, and may be considered as part of multimodal analgesia to decrease chronic pain incidence, neuropathic pain and improve acute postoperative pain control.
TRIAL REGISTRATION: Clinicaltrials.gov (NCT06019325 registered August 17, 2023).

makaleler.baslik: Psychosocial Outcomes Among Women with Early-stage Breast Cancer Undergoing Mastectomy: A Systematic Review.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Mastektomi Geçiren Erken Evre Meme Kanserinde Psikososyal Sonuçlar
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 20 çalışmanın incelendiği sistematik derlemede, mastektominin birden fazla alanda zayıf psikososyal sonuçlarla ilişkili olduğu görüldü. Meme koruyucu cerrahi, mastektomiye kıyasla daha iyi vücut imajı (%67) ve fiziksel sağlık (%38) ile ilişkilendirildi.
makaleler.ozet:
INTRODUCTION: Women undergoing mastectomy for early-stage breast cancer experience physical, emotional, and psychosocial sequalae after surgery. This impact on women's identity, body image, and self-esteem is often studied in isolation, limiting the ability to capture the multidimensional nature of post-mastectomy recovery. Our systematic review aimed to characterize the range of patient-reported outcome measures (PROMs) used to assess postoperative psychosocial experiences.
METHODS: Three databases were queried for relevant articles from January 1, 1997 to October 25, 2024 using keywords and controlled vocabulary for mastectomy, patient reported outcome measures, and psychology.
RESULTS: Twenty studies met inclusion criteria. Most were single-institution, cross-sectional studies. More than half of the studies (60%) reported a mean or median participant age between 50-60 years. Most studies that reported participant race (72%) included > 80% White women. Thirty-eight different PROMs were used across 15 studies. Most instruments were used in only one study. Three studies developed their own measures. Seven psychosocial domains were identified: quality of life, sexual health/sexual function, body image, mental health, pain/physical health, psychosocial health, and satisfaction. Compared with mastectomy, breast conservation surgery was associated with better body image (67%) and physical health (38%) as well as improved psychosocial outcomes and satisfaction; reconstruction improved but did not eliminate these differences.
CONCLUSIONS: Mastectomy is associated with poor psychosocial outcomes across multiple domains, yet this is often disregarded as a critical component of postoperative recovery. These findings highlight the critical need to better prepare women for mastectomy and identify tailored support strategies to improve patient-reported outcomes.
PROTOCOL REGISTRATION: The study protocol was registered with the International Prospective Register of Systematic Reviews (PROSPERO) (Registration number: CRD42024XXXXXX).

makaleler.baslik: Diagnostic accuracy of ultrasound-based imaging modalities for assessing residual axillary lymph node disease after neoadjuvant chemotherapy in patients with breast cancer: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: NAC Sonrasi Aksiller Lenf Nodu Degerlendirilmesinde Ultrason Yontemleri
makaleler.kisa_ozet: NAC sonrasi rezidu aksiller lenf nodu hastaligini degerlendiren 14 makalenin dahil edildigi meta-analizde, konvansiyonel US icin duyarlilik 0,55 ve ozgulluk 0.79 bulunurken, AI/radiomics modellerinde duyarlilik 0,93 ve ozgulluk 0,82 olarak saptanmistir. Mevcut veriler tek basina goruntuleme ile aksiller cerrahinin atlanmasini desteklememektedir.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Accurate identification of residual axillary lymph node (ALN) disease after neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NAC) is essential for treatment planning and for evaluating potential surgical de-escalation. We assessed the diagnostic performance of conventional ultrasonography (US), shear-wave elastography (SWE), artificial intelligence (AI)/radiomics, and multimodal ultrasound-based models for post-NAC axillary restaging.
METHODS: PubMed, Embase, the Cochrane Library, and Web of Science were searched from inception through December 2025. Histopathology after axillary surgery was the reference standard, and residual axillary nodal disease (ypN+) was uniformly defined as the positive target condition. Study-level 2×2 tables were harmonized to this direction. Risk of bias and applicability were assessed with the Quality Assessment of Diagnostic Accuracy Studies-2 (QUADAS-2) tool. Bivariate random-effects models and hierarchical summary receiver operating characteristic (HSROC) curves were used for modality groups with a sufficient number of independent studies; the positive likelihood ratio (PLR) and negative likelihood ratio (NLR) were pooled with random-effects models. Potentially overlapping cohorts were examined in sensitivity analyses. The study protocol was registered in PROSPERO (International Prospective Register of Systematic Reviews; registration No. CRD420251271199).
RESULTS: A total of 14 articles were included in the systematic review, 10 of which contributed 12 test-level datasets to the quantitative synthesis. For conventional US (six studies), the pooled sensitivity was 0.55 [95% confidence interval (CI): 0.36-0.73], the pooled specificity was 0.79 (95% CI: 0.73-0.84), the area under the HSROC curve (AUC) was 0.78, and the pooled PLR and NLR were 2.47 (95% CI: 1.42-4.28) and 0.54 (95% CI: 0.30-0.95), respectively. AI/radiomics models (three studies) showed a pooled sensitivity of 0.93 (95% CI: 0.80-0.98), a specificity of 0.82 (95% CI: 0.60-0.94), and an AUC of 0.94; however, likelihood-ratio CIs were wide, and the bivariate covariance estimate reached the boundary. Evidence for SWE was limited to two potentially overlapping reports, and only one multimodal combined-model study had a complete harmonized 2×2 table. At a 40% pretest probability, a negative conventional US result reduced the posttest probability of residual nodal disease to approximately 26%.
CONCLUSIONS: Conventional US alone does not reliably exclude residual axillary nodal disease after NAC. AI/radiomics approaches show promising diagnostic performance, but the evidence for this is sparse, heterogeneous, and imprecise. The currently available data do not support definitive modality ranking or omission of axillary surgery on the basis of imaging alone, and prospective multicenter external validation is required.
makaleler.dergi_tam: Quantitative imaging in medicine and surgery

tez.baslik: Meme kanseri tanılı hastalarda BRCA ve non-BRCA gen mutasyonlarının klinikopatolojik özellikleri: Tek merkez retrospektif çalışma
tez.baslik_tr: Meme Kanserinde BRCA ve Non-BRCA Gen Mutasyonları
tez.kisa_ozet: 925 hastanın incelendiği çalışmada, 166 hastada (%17,9) P/LP varyant saptandı; en sık BRCA2, BRCA1, CHEK2, MUTYH ve ATM genleri görüldü. BRCA grubunda aile öyküsü daha sık, Ki-67 indeksi ve triple-negatif alt tip oranı daha yüksek bulundu.
tez.ozet: Amaç: Bu çalışma, germline multigen panel uygulanan meme kanseri hastalarında BRCA1/2 ve non-BRCA patojenik/olası patojenik (P/LP) varyantların dağılımını, klinikopatolojik özelliklerle ilişkisini ve BRCA ile non-BRCA taşıyıcıları arasındaki farklılıkları değerlendirmek amacıyla yapıldı. Gereç ve Yöntem: Ocak 2014–Mart 2026 arasında Gazi Üniversitesi Tıp Fakültesi Genel Cerrahi Anabilim Dalı'nda meme kanseri tanısıyla takip edilen, germline genetik test istenen ve sonucuna ulaşılabilen 925 hasta retrospektif olarak değerlendirildi. Tüm hastalara 58 genlik germline multigen panel uygulandı. Primer analizler P/LP varyantlar üzerinden yapıldı; VUS, benign/olası benign ve negatif sonuçlar dışlandı. P/LP varyant taşıyıcıları BRCA ve non-BRCA gruplarına ayrılarak karşılaştırıldı. Bulgular: 925 hastanın 166'sında (%17,9) P/LP varyant saptandı ve toplam 179 P/LP varyant kaydedildi. Ortanca yaş 46,5 yıl (IQR: 41–55) idi. En sık saptanan genler BRCA2 (n=37) ve BRCA1 (n=24) olup, non-BRCA genler arasında en sık CHEK2 (n=21), MUTYH (n=16) ve ATM (n=15) varyantları izlendi. On üç hastada birden fazla P/LP varyant mevcuttu. BRCA1 varyantları taşıyan hastalarda triple-negatif fenotiple ön plandayken, BRCA2 ve sık saptanan non-BRCA genlerde luminal alt tipler baskındı. BRCA ve non-BRCA grupları karşılaştırıldığında BRCA grubunda aile öyküsü daha sık, ER/PR pozitifliği daha düşük, Ki-67 proliferasyon indeksi ve triple-negatif alt tip oranı daha yüksek bulundu. Tümör boyutu BRCA grubunda daha düşük saptandı. Histolojik tip, grade, LVI, PNI, metastatik lenf nodu sayısı ve N evresi açısından anlamlı fark izlenmedi. Sonuç: Meme kanserinde herediter yatkınlık BRCA1/2 ile sınırlı değildir. Non-BRCA varyantlar heterojen olup gen-spesifik ve klinikopatolojik bağlamda değerlendirilmelidir. BRCA ve non-BRCA grupları arasında hormon reseptör durumu, Ki-67 proliferasyon indeksi ve moleküler alt tip dağılımı açısından farklılıklar saptanmıştır. Anahtar kelimeler: Meme kanseri, germline mutasyon, BRCA, non-BRCA, multigen panel, klinikopatolojik özellikler

makaleler.baslik: The Japanese Hernia Society (JHS) Guidelines for Adult Groin Hernia Management 2024.
makaleler.baslik_tr: JHS 2024 Erişkin Kasık Hernisi Yönetimi Kılavuzu
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Japon Herni Derneği (JHS) 2024 kılavuzu; tanı, sınıflandırma, cerrahi endikasyonlar, teknikler, mesh tespiti, anestezi, kronik ağrı ve acil herni yönetimi konularında öneriler sunar. Deneyimli cerrahlar tarafından seçilmiş hastalarda laparoskopik onarım tercih edilirken, açık anterior mesh onarımı uygun durumlarda geçerliliğini korur.
makaleler.ozet: Groin hernia is a common surgical condition. The Japanese Hernia Society (JHS) Guidelines for Groin Hernia Management 2024 were developed to reflect both international evidence and the realities of clinical practice in Japan. This article is an authorized English translation of a summary of the adult section of the JHS Guidelines for Groin Hernia Management 2024, presenting key clinical questions, recommendations, and concise explanations for an international readership. It covers diagnosis, classification, surgical indications, operative approaches, mesh and fixation, anesthesia, chronic postoperative inguinal pain, recurrent and emergency hernia, training, cost-effectiveness, and registry-based outcome assessment; relevant differences from the international HerniaSurge guidelines are discussed. Laparoscopic repair is favored in selected patients when performed by experienced surgeons, particularly for pain reduction and early recovery, whereas open anterior mesh repair remains appropriate when general anesthesia or laparoscopy is unsuitable. For femoral hernia, chronic pain management, recurrent hernia, and incarcerated or strangulated hernia, evidence remains limited, leading to cautious or conditional recommendations.

makaleler.baslik: Optimal Etomidate Induction Dosage Combined With Nerve Block Minimizes Postoperative Cognitive Dysfunction and Enhances Hemodynamic Stability in Elderly Hernia Patients.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Yaşlı Herni Cerrahisinde Optimal Etomidat Dozu ve Sinir Bloğu
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 106 yaşlı herni hastasında yapılan RCT'de, orta doz (0,2 mg/kg) etomidat ve sinir bloğu kombinasyonunun hemodinamik stabiliteyi artırdığı ve 1. günde postoperatif kognitif disfonksiyon (POCD) oranını %8,3'e, advers olayları %13,9'a düşürdüğü gösterilmiştir. Yüksek doz (0,3 mg/kg) ise %40,0 POCD ve %28,6 hipotansiyon oranlarıyla ilişki bulunmuştur.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Etomidate combined with nerve block is commonly used for elderly hernia surgery, but standardized dosing regimens remain lacking.
OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to evaluate the effects of different induction doses of etomidate combined with nerve block on hemodynamic stability and cognitive function in elderly hernia patients, aiming to optimize the induction strategy.
METHODS: 106 elderly patients scheduled for elective hernia surgery were randomly assigned to low-dose (0.1 mg/kg, n = 35), medium-dose (0.2 mg/kg, n = 36), or high-dose (0.3 mg/kg, n = 35) etomidate groups. All received sufentanil 0.3 μg/kg and remimazolam 0.3 mg/kg with nerve block. Intraoperative vital signs, postoperative cognitive function, and adverse events were compared. Multivariate analysis identified postoperative cognitive dysfunction (POCD) risk factors.
RESULTS: The medium-dose group showed superior hemodynamic stability with smaller fluctuations in mean arterial pressure (MAP), systolic blood pressure (SBP), and heart rate (HR), the lowest POCD rate on day 1 (8.3%) and lowest adverse events (13.9%), and shorter recovery and hospital stays. The high-dose group had the highest hypotension (28.6%) and POCD (40.0%) rates. Age ≥75 years, high-dose etomidate, and operative time >60 minutes were independent POCD risk factors.
CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: Etomidate 0.2 mg/kg with nerve block achieves favorable hemodynamics and minimizes POCD and adverse reactions in elderly hernia surgery, supporting a moderate-dose strategy for this vulnerable population.

makaleler.baslik: Negative pressure incisional wound therapy for high-risk ventral hernia repair: a randomized controlled trial and meta-analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Yüksek Riskli Ventral Herni Onarımında Negatif Basınçlı Yara Tedavisi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 110 hastada yapılan çok merkezli RCT ve meta-analizde, profilaktik negatif basınçlı yara tedavisinin (NPWT) cerrahi alan komplikasyonlarını azalttığı (NPWT grubunda %27,8'e karşı kontrol grubunda %47,2; RR 0,59; %95 CI 0,35-0,99), yaşam kalitesini artırdığı ve maliyet-etkin olduğu gösterilmiştir.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Despite advances in prosthetic material and surgical technique, wound-related complications after ventral hernia repairs remain common and a primary determinant of postoperative morbidity. We sought to evaluate negative pressure wound therapy (NPWT), a low-cost intervention to improve wound outcomes that has been proven in other surgical contexts.
METHODS: We report a multicentre randomized controlled trial (RCT) evaluating NPWT versus sterile dressing in adult patients undergoing surgical repair of ventral hernias with 1 or more risk factors for postoperative surgical site complications. Our primary outcome was the composite of any surgical site complication. Secondary outcomes were cost-effectiveness and quality of life, evaluated using the Hernia-Related Quality-of-Life Survey (HerQLes). We conducted a meta-analysis of this study and 2 other RCTs.
RESULTS: Of 110 patients who met inclusion criteria, 107 had primary outcome data at a median follow-up of 33 days. The primary outcome occurred in 15 (27.8%) of 54 patients in the NPWT group and 25 (47.2%) of 53 patients in the control group, for a relative risk of 0.59 (95% confidence interval [CI] 0.35 to 0.99). Meta-analysis found a pooled relative risk of 0.56 (95% CI 0.39 to 0.81). Postoperative quality of life was significantly higher in the NPWT group (HerQLes score 88.3 [95% CI 75.8 to 94.2] v. 73.3 [95% CI 52.5 to 93.3]). Cost-effectiveness of the NPWT was US$160 per quality-adjusted life year.
CONCLUSION: Prophylactic NPWT in high-risk ventral hernia repair reduces the incidence of surgical site complications, is associated with a higher postoperative quality of life, and is highly cost-effective.
makaleler.dergi_tam: Canadian journal of surgery. Journal canadien de chirurgie

makaleler.baslik: Twelve-month outcomes after fixation-free, 3-dimensional, lightweight SWING-Mesh implantation for minimally-invasive inguinal hernia repair: a multicenter prospective observational study.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Fiksasyonsuz SWING-Mesh ile Kasık Hernisi Onarımının On İki Aylık Sonuçları
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 19 merkezli prospektif çalışmada 294 olgunun 233'ü 12. ayda değerlendirildi ve nüks oranı %2,15 (95% CI %0,7-%4,94) olarak saptandı. 3. aydan 12. aya kadar ağrı skorlarının düşmeye devam ettiği ve ağrısız hasta oranının %93,1'e yükseldiği görüldü.
makaleler.ozet:
INTRODUCTION: Long-term independent evidence regarding new mesh types used in inguinal hernia repair is scarce. We previously reported favorable 3-month outcomes for the fixation-free 3-dimensional SWING-Mesh, but early follow-up precluded capturing recurrence or persistent pain.
AIM: We aimed to assess recurrence, pain, and complications 12 months after fixation-free SWING-Mesh implantation in transabdominal preperitoneal and totally extraperitoneal repairs.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: A prospective observational cohort study was performed in 19 Polish centers. Consecutive adults undergoing elective laparoendoscopic repair with unfixed SWING-Mesh were enrolled; large direct (M3) defects and emergency procedures were excluded. The unit of analysis was the operated groin. Assessments were performed at discharge, 7-10 days, 30 days, 3 months, and at 12 months following surgery. The primary end point was recurrence; secondary end points were pain (Visual Analog Scale [VAS], 0-10 points) and complications.
RESULTS: Of 294 cases, 233 (79.3%) were assessed at 12 months; 61 (20.7%) were lost to follow-up. Recurrence was identified in 5 cases (2.15%; 95% CI, 0.7%-4.94%), as compared with none at 3 months. Pain decreased throughout the observation period (Friedman test, P <0.001). In contrast to the 3-month analysis, in which scores at 30 days and 3 months showed no difference, pain scores decreased further between 3 and 12 months (P <0.001), and the number of pain-free cases increased from 78.5% to 93.1%. One case (0.43%) had a VAS score of 4 or higher. Complications remained at 6.9%, with no cases of seroma or hematoma.
CONCLUSIONS: Fixation-free SWING-Mesh repair demonstrated a 12-month recurrence rate below the prespecified noninferiority margin, very low persistent pain, and complete resolution of structural complications, with pain scores continuing to improve beyond 3 months.

makaleler.baslik: Minimally invasive extraperitoneal reconstruction of lateral incisional hernias without posterior component separation: early multicenter outcomes.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Lateral İnsizyonel Hernilerde Minimal İnvaziv Ekstraperitoneal Rekonstrüksiyon
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 47 hastayı kapsayan retrospektif çok merkezli kohort çalışmasında, posterior komponent ayırma gerektirmeyen kişiselleştirilmiş minimal invaziv preperitoneal strateji (Pe-TEP veya Carolina's crossover) ile tam rekonstrüksiyon sağlanmıştır. Cerrahi alan komplikasyon oranı %6,4 olup, takip süresince nüks veya kronik ağrı bildirilmemiştir.
makaleler.ozet:
PURPOSE: Lateral incisional hernias remain technically challenging, and evidence supporting minimally invasive extraperitoneal reconstruction is scarce. We describe a tailored minimally invasive preperitoneal strategy avoiding posterior component separation and evaluate its early multicenter outcomes.
METHODS: A retrospective multicenter cohort study included consecutive patients undergoing minimally invasive preperitoneal reconstruction for lateral incisional hernias between April 2024 and May 2026 at three specialized abdominal wall centers. Surgical access was individualized according to the condition of the linea alba and reconstructive requirements using direct Pe-TEP or Carolina's crossover. The primary outcome was technical success without posterior component separation. Secondary outcomes included perioperative variables, surgical site occurrences (SSOs), length of stay, readmissions, reoperations, chronic pain, and recurrence.
RESULTS: Forty-seven patients underwent minimally invasive lateral preperitoneal reconstruction. Carolina's crossover was performed in 24 (51.1%) and direct Pe-TEP in 23 (48.9%). Concomitant midline and lateral hernias were present in 55.3%. Reconstruction was achieved in all patients without posterior component separation or open conversion. Median mesh area was 900 cm² (IQR 600-936), mean operative time 241 ± 90 minutes, and median length of stay 1 day (IQR 1-2). SSO rate was 6.4%, with no surgical site infections or procedural intervention. Median follow-up was 13.0 months (IQR 4.5-16.0). No recurrences, chronic mesh infections, chronic pain, readmissions, or reoperations occurred.
CONCLUSION: A tailored minimally invasive preperitoneal strategy enables complete reconstruction of lateral incisional hernias without posterior component separation. These early multicenter outcomes support this strategy as an alternative for lateral abdominal wall reconstruction.

tez.baslik: Parastomal hernide risk faktörleri ve sarkopeni ile ilişkisi
tez.baslik_tr: Parastomal Hernide Risk Faktörleri ve Sarkopeni ile İlişkisi
tez.kisa_ozet: Stoma açılan 239 hastanın incelendiği retrospektif çalışmada parastomal herni insidansı %45,2 bulundu. Çok değişkenli analizde cinsiyet (OR=3,013; p=0,003), yaş (OR=1,042; p=0,003), VKİ (OR=1,173; p=0,001) ve albümin düzeyinin (OR=1,105; p<0,001) bağımsız risk faktörleri olduğu gösterildi.
tez.ozet: Amaç: Bu çalışmanın amacı, stoma oluşturulan hastalarda parastomal herni insidansını belirlemek, herni gelişiminde rol oynayan risk faktörlerini değerlendirmek ve sarkopeninin parastomal herni gelişimi üzerindeki etkisini araştırmaktır. Gereç ve Yöntem: Bu retrospektif çalışmaya, stoma oluşturulan toplam 239 hasta dahil edildi. Hastalar parastomal herni gelişen ve gelişmeyen gruplar olarak ikiye ayrıldı. Demografik özellikler, klinik veriler, cerrahi parametreler, laboratuvar bulguları ve radyolojik ölçümler karşılaştırıldı. Sarkopeni değerlendirmesi psoas kas indeksi (PMI) kullanılarak yapıldı. PMI'nin sarkopeniyi öngörmedeki tanısal değeri ROC analizi ile değerlendirildi. Bağımsız risk faktörlerini belirlemek amacıyla çok değişkenli lojistik regresyon analizi uygulandı. Bulgular: Çalışmada parastomal herni insidansı %45,2 olarak saptandı. Herni gelişen hastalarda yaş ve vücut kitle indeksi anlamlı derecede yüksek bulunurken, kadın cinsiyetin daha yüksek oranda olduğu görüldü (p<0,05). Çok değişkenli analizde cinsiyet (OR=3,013; p=0,003), yaş (OR=1,042; p=0,003), VKİ (OR=1,173; p=0,001) ve albümin düzeyi (OR=1,105; p<0,001) bağımsız risk faktörleri olarak belirlendi. Tanı dağılımında kolorektal kanserlerin herni gelişen grupta daha yüksek oranda olduğu saptandı (p<0,001). Ayrıca komorbidite varlığı (p=0,015), kemoterapi öyküsü (p=0,025) ve postoperatif kemoterapi (p=0,018) herni gelişen grupta daha yüksek bulundu. PMI değerleri açısından herni gelişen ve gelişmeyen gruplar arasında anlamlı fark saptanmadı (p=0,464). PMI cut-off değerine göre yapılan karşılaştırmada da anlamlı ilişki bulunmadı (p=0,360). Buna karşın sarkopeni varlığı değerlendirildiğinde herni gelişmeyen grupta sarkopeni oranının daha yüksek olduğu görüldü (p=0,044). Cinsiyete göre yapılan analizlerde bu farkın özellikle erkek hastalarda anlamlı olduğu saptandı (p=0,041). Cerrahi açıdan değerlendirildiğinde rektum ve sigmoid cerrahilerinin herni gelişen grupta daha yüksek olduğu (p=0,002), elektif cerrahilerin herni gelişimi ile ilişkili olduğu (p=0,043) saptandı. Ayrıca herni gelişen hastalarda takip süresinin daha uzun olduğu görüldü (p=0,011). Sonuç: Parastomal herni gelişimi multifaktöriyel bir süreç olup; yaş, cinsiyet, VKİ ve albümin düzeyi bağımsız risk faktörleri olarak öne çıkmaktadır. Sarkopeni ile parastomal herni arasındaki ilişkinin beklenen doğrultuda olmadığı ve cinsiyete göre farklılık gösterebileceği görülmüştür. PMI'nin tek başına herni gelişimini öngörmede sınırlı değere sahip olduğu saptanmıştır. Bu bulgular, parastomal herni gelişiminde yalnızca kas kitlesinin değil, vücut kompozisyonunun daha kompleks bileşenlerinin de rol oynayabileceğini düşündürmektedir. Daha geniş ve prospektif çalışmalar ile bu ilişkinin daha net ortaya konmasına ihtiyaç bulunmaktadır. Anahtar Kelimeler: Parastomal herni; Stoma; Sarkopeni; Psoas kas indeksi; Vücut kitle indeksi

makaleler.baslik: Prevalence and prognostic significance of respiratory failure before or at liver transplantation in acute-on-chronic liver failure: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Karaciğer Transplantasyonunda Solunum Yetmezliğinin Prevalansı ve Prognozu
makaleler.kisa_ozet: ACLF hastalarında transplantasyon öncesi veya sırasında solunum yetmezliği prevalansı ve prognostik önemi incelendi. 33 çalışmayı içeren meta-analizde, 1 yıllık post-transplant sağkalım solunum yetmezliği pozitif alıcılarda %55,3, negatif alıcılarda ise %82,1 bulundu. Solunum yetmezliği pozitif olanlarda 1 yıllık mortalite daha yüksekti (unadjusted RR 2,41; %95 CI 1,50-3,90).
makaleler.ozet: Respiratory failure (RF) is an important organ failure phenotype in acute-on-chronic liver failure (ACLF), but its prevalence and prognostic significance among liver transplant (LT) recipients remain uncertain. We searched PubMed, Embase, and the Web of Science Core Collection for observational studies through August 17, 2026. Of 33 included study reports, clinically comparable data were pooled using random-effects meta-analysis; other evidence was synthesized narratively. Pooled RF prevalence was 7.5% (95% CI: 2.1%-23.0%) at earlier pretransplant assessment, 13.5% (5.7%-28.5%) among recipients with EASL-CLIF ACLF assessed on the day of LT, and 28.9% (9.7%-60.6%) among recipients with ACLF-3 assessed near LT. A broad analysis of 21 reports yielded 12.9% (9.0%-18.1%; 95% prediction interval: 3.3%-38.9%). Across three independent cohorts, pooled 1-year post-LT survival was 55.3% (20.0%-86.0%) in RF-positive recipients and 82.1% (66.9%-91.2%) in RF-negative recipients. RF-positive recipients had higher 1-year mortality (unadjusted RR = 2.41, 95% CI: 1.50-3.90). One study reported 6-month mortality RRs versus non-ACLF recipients of 2.02 (95% CI: 1.23-3.30) without RF and 6.96 (95% CI: 4.84-10.00) with RF. Overall, RF was consistently associated with higher post-transplant mortality, but adjusted evidence remains insufficient to establish its independent prognostic value. Interpretation should account for RF assessment timing, ACLF severity, concurrent organ failures, and transplant selection practices.

makaleler.baslik: Normothermic machine perfusion for viability assessment and rescue of non-utilized donor livers: A systematic review and zone-resolved appraisal of viability criteria.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Donör Karaciğerlerinin Değerlendirilmesinde Normotermik Makine Perfüzyonu
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Kabul edilmeyen donör karaciğerlerinin normotermik makine perfüzyonu (NMP) ile değerlendirilmesi ve kurtarılması incelendi. 11 çalışmadan 219 perfüze karaciğerin 148'i (%68) transplantasyona alındı (medyan kurtarma oranı %71). Greft sağkalımı %72 ile %100 arasında değişti.
makaleler.ozet: Conventional clinical criteria characterize the viability of marginal donor livers imprecisely and drive non-utilization. Normothermic machine perfusion (NMP) permits ex situ assessment before transplantation. We summarized clinical evidence on NMP-based viability assessment of declined livers, quantified rescue, and appraised the viability criteria against hepatic zonation. PubMed and Embase were searched on 23 July 2026, with a broadened PubMed update on 24 October 2026. Records were screened in duplicate following PRISMA 2020. Risk of bias was assessed with ROBINS-I or the Joanna Briggs Institute checklist for case series, and certainty of evidence with GRADE. Heterogeneity precluded meta-analysis; synthesis was narrative. Across nine non-overlapping clinical cohorts from eleven non-randomized studies, 148 of 219 perfused livers (68%) were transplanted (unweighted median rescue rate 71%, range 48.5-100%): 74% under NMP alone and 57% under sequential hypothermic-to-normothermic perfusion, a contrast confounded by donor type and acceptance thresholds. Arms without transplant intent reached potential rescue rates of 70% and 71%. Graft survival ranged from 72% to 100% (median 94%) and patient survival from 82% to 100% (follow-up 6 weeks to 60 months); early allograft dysfunction ranged from 0% to 50%. Because only perfused grafts were counted, these proportions cannot quantify the incremental effect of NMP on organ availability; certainty of evidence was very low for all outcomes. Mapped onto hepatic zonation, all eleven studies assessed periportal and biliary function, but none applied a pericentral criterion. NMP can rescue many declined livers, but its decision criteria appear spatially incomplete, a hypothesis that requires prospective testing.

makaleler.baslik: Post-transplant oncologic outcomes after locoregional downstaging before living donor liver transplantation for hepatocellular carcinoma beyond Milan criteria: a systematic review and meta-analysis of selected cohorts.
makaleler.baslik_tr: HCC'de Milan Kriterleri Ötesi Canlı Vericili Karaciğer Transplantasyonu
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Milan kriterleri ötesindeki HCC hastalarında canlı vericili karaciğer transplantasyonu öncesi lokorejyonel downstaging sonuçları değerlendirildi. 511 hastayı içeren 17 çalışmada rekürrens %22,1, 5 yıllık genel sağkalım %75,8 ve downstaging başarı oranı %47,5 olarak bulundu.
makaleler.ozet: Downstaging of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) before liver transplantation is established mainly in the deceased donor setting, and outcomes before living donor liver transplantation (LDLT) remain unclear. We searched PubMed and Embase through April 2026 for studies reporting post-transplant outcomes in patients with HCC beyond Milan criteria who were downstaged before LDLT. A pre-specified primary analysis covered locoregional therapy targeting Milan or UCSF criteria. We pooled proportions using random-effects models and reconstructed patient-level survival from Kaplan-Meier curves. Seventeen studies with 511 downstaged LDLT recipients were included. In the primary cohort, recurrence was 22.1% (95% CI 9.7-42.6) and 5-year overall survival 75.8% (61.8-85.8). Across all studies, recurrence was 25.0% (17.4-34.5), 5-year overall survival 75.0% (63.1-84.1), and downstaging success 47.5% (36.1-59.1); reconstructed 5-year overall and recurrence-free survival were 75.7% and 75.6%. These estimates describe patients who achieved downstaging-fewer than half of those who attempted it-and then reached transplant. They do not measure the benefit of downstaging itself. The evidence remains retrospective and mostly Asian, with wide variation between studies. Prospective intention-to-treat studies are needed.

makaleler.baslik: Prognostic Significance of Early Donor-derived Cell-free DNA Trajectories After Kidney Transplantation.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Böbrek Transplantasyonunda Erken Hücresiz DNA Seyrinin Prognostik Önemi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Prospektif çok merkezli 1137 böbrek alıcısında, ilk 4 ayda bakılan donor-derived cell-free DNA (dd-cfDNA) seviyelerinin uzun dönem greft sonuçları ile ilişkisi incelendi. Sürekli düşük dd-cfDNA %83,7 hastada görülürken, kalıcı yükseklik hastaların %3,3'ünde görüldü ve %20 greft kaybı ile ilişkilendirildi. Geç veya kalıcı yükseklik, rejeksiyon ve greft kaybı riskini bağımsız olarak artırmaktadır.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Early post-transplant elevations in donor-derived cell-free DNA are often attributed to ischemia-reperfusion injury, with uncertain prognostic significance. We assessed whether donor-derived cell-free DNA (dd-cfDNA) results during the first 4 mo post-transplantation are associated with long-term graft outcomes.
METHODS: We analyzed 1137 kidney transplant recipients enrolled in the prospective multicenter Kidney Outcomes AlloSure Registry. Recipients were categorized into 4 trajectory groups based on dd-cfDNA measurements obtained within the first 4 mo post-transplant: consistently low, transient-elevation, late-elevation, and persistent-elevation. Associations with donor-specific antibody (DSA) development, rejection, graft dysfunction, and graft loss were evaluated over 3 y using hazard regression, with multivariable models adjusted for calculated Panel Reactive Antibody (cPRA) and retransplant.
RESULTS: Among the 1137 recipients, 83.7% exhibited consistently low dd-cfDNA, 9.8% transient-elevation, 3.2% late-elevation, and 3.3% persistent-elevation. Late elevation was associated with the highest cumulative incidence of DSA development, whereas persistent-elevation had the highest incidence of rejection, graft dysfunction, and graft loss. Graft loss occurred in 20.0% of recipients with persistent-elevation and 8.8% with late-elevation and was uncommon among consistently low (2.2%) and transient (2.9%) groups. On multivariable analysis, late elevation was independently associated with DSA development, rejection, and graft loss, and persistent-elevation with rejection, graft dysfunction, and graft loss, regardless of prior transplantation or sensitization status.
CONCLUSIONS: Early dd-cfDNA trajectories stratify kidney transplant recipients into clinically meaningful risk phenotypes. Persistent or late-emerging elevation identifies patients at independently increased risk of rejection and graft loss, with persistent-elevation also associated with graft dysfunction, supporting serial dd-cfDNA monitoring as a tool for early post-transplant risk stratification.

makaleler.baslik: Indian Society of Organ Transplantation Consensus Recommendations on Latent Tuberculosis in Kidney Transplantation.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Böbrek Transplantasyonunda Latent Tüberküloz Kılavuzu
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Güney ve Güneydoğu Asya'da böbrek transplantasyonunda latent tüberküloz yönetimi için ISOT konsensus önerileri oluşturuldu. Uzman paneli 11 alanda 36 konsensus bildirisi hazırladı. Rutin pretransplant tarama önerilirken, IGRA testi tüberküloz enfeksiyonu tanısında tercih edilen yöntem olarak belirlendi.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Tuberculosis remains a principal cause of morbidity and mortality after kidney transplantation across South and Southeast Asia, where tuberculosis infection is prevalent. India carries one-quarter of the global tuberculosis burden, yet transplant-specific guidance for high-burden settings is scarce. The Indian Society of Organ Transplantation (ISOT) convened a multidisciplinary expert panel to formulate consensus recommendations for the management of tuberculosis infection in kidney transplantation.
METHODS: A multidisciplinary panel undertook a structured, evidence-informed consensus process, appraising MEDLINE, EMBASE, Scopus, the Cochrane Library, and national tuberculosis program documents. Statements were refined through successive revision rounds, panel discussion at the ISOT Mid-Term Conference (Bengaluru, May 2026), and confirmation by all authors, preceding executive committee endorsement. Each statement received an evidence level (1-5) and, where actionable, a recommendation strength.
RESULTS: The panel formulated 36 consensus statements across 11 domains. Routine pre-transplant screening for tuberculosis infection is endorsed, with exclusion of tuberculosis disease before treatment of tuberculosis infection. The interferon-gamma release assay (IGRA) is preferred, given confounding of the tuberculin skin test by bacille Calmette-Guérin (BCG) vaccination; a Mycobacterium tuberculosis-specific antigen-based skin test (Cy-Tb) is an acceptable alternative where IGRA is unavailable or unaffordable. Isoniazid-based regimens are preferred, as rifampicin reduces calcineurin-inhibitor exposure; isoniazid resistance, hepatotoxicity, and hepatitis C co-infection warrant individualized therapy.
CONCLUSION: This first India-specific, society-endorsed position statement provides context-adapted recommendations for the management of tuberculosis infection in kidney transplantation and may inform adaptation in other high-burden settings; prospective multicenter studies are needed.

makaleler.baslik: Evaluating the Association of Fecal Diversion with Morbidity in Patients Undergoing CRS/HIPEC with Pelvic Anastomoses: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Pelvik Anastomozlu CRS/HIPEC'te Fekal Diversiyonun Morbiditeye Etkisi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Toplam 1506 hastanın dahil olduğu meta-analizde, diversiyon anastomoz kaçağında istatistiksel olarak anlamlı bir azalma sağlamadı (OR 0,67; %95 CI 0,32-1,39; p=0,28). Diversiyon, 60 günlük yeniden yatış oranlarında artışla ilişkili bulundu (OR 3,29; %95 CI 1,52-7,11; p<0,01).
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Cytoreductive surgery with hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy (CRS/HIPEC) is an established treatment for peritoneal surface malignancies, but is associated with substantial morbidity, particularly when pelvic anastomoses are performed. Diverting ostomies are commonly used to mitigate complications related to anastomotic leak; however, ostomy formation carries its own morbidity, and its benefit in this setting remains controversial.
PATIENTS AND METHODS: PubMed and Embase were queried for studies of patients undergoing CRS/HIPEC with a pelvic anastomosis, documented use of diverting ostomy, and reported anastomotic leak rates. Eligible studies required combined CRS/HIPEC, explicit reporting of diversion status, and perioperative outcomes stratified by ostomy presence. Abstracts were independently screened by two reviewers, followed by full-text review for final inclusion. A binary odds ratio meta-analysis was performed comparing anastomotic leak between diverted and non-diverted patients.
RESULTS: Of 506 studies identified, 10 met inclusion criteria and were combined with our institutional cohort, comprising 1506 patients. Overall, diversion was not associated with a statistically significant reduction in anastomotic leak (OR 0.67, 95% CI 0.32-1.39, p = 0.28). No differences were observed in grade ≥ 3 complications or length of stay. Diversion was associated with increased 60-day readmissions (OR 3.29, 95% CI 1.52-7.11, p < 0.01).
CONCLUSIONS: Diverting ostomies were not associated with a statistically significant reduction in anastomotic leak in patients undergoing CRS/HIPEC with a pelvic anastomosis. These findings suggest consideration of a selective, rather than routine, diversion strategy in appropriately selected patients.

makaleler.baslik: Pleomorphic Sarcoma of the Liver: A Systematic Review and Pooled Analysis of 90 Patients.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Karaciğerin Pleomorfik Sarkomu: 90 Hastalık Sistematik Derleme
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Seksen dokuz derleme hastası ve 1 kurumsal olgunun incelendiği çalışmada ortanca yaş 56 ve hastaların %63,3'ü erkekti. Cerrahi rezeksiyon birincil küratif amaçlı tedaviyken (%95,7), 1 yıllık, 3 yıllık ve 5 yıllık genel sağkalım oranları sırasıyla %75,9, %42,7 ve %21,4 oldu.
makaleler.ozet:
INTRODUCTION: Undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma (UPS) of the liver is rare, posing diagnostic and therapeutic challenges. Given the sparsity of evidence outside case reports, we present an institutional case and a systematic review of the literature to better describe the clinical characteristics and outcomes of primary hepatic UPS.
METHODS: A systematic review of the PubMed, Embase, and Cochrane Library databases was performed according to the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses statement (end-of-search date: 4/26/2025). Studies reporting clinical and treatment data on patients with primary hepatic UPS were included. In parallel, an institutional case of primary hepatic UPS managed with multimodal therapy and central hepatectomy is presented.
RESULTS: Forty-seven studies reporting on 89 patients were identified through the systematic review, and one institutional case was included. The median age was 56 y and 63.3% were male. Most patients were symptomatic (93.9%), and median tumor size was 10.8 cm. Surgical resection was the primary curative-intent treatment (95.7%). Crude overall survival was 34.3% at a median follow up of 6.5 mo, with 1-y, 3-y, and 5-y overall survival rates of 75.9%, 42.7%, and 21.4%, respectively. Recurrence occurred in 59.2% of curatively treated patients, with a median time to recurrence of 4.5 mo.
CONCLUSIONS: Primary hepatic UPS is rare with variable presentation and poor prognosis. Surgical resection is the predominant treatment, though there is insufficient data to determine its independent effect on survival. Further studies with standardized diagnostic and treatment data are needed to better define optimal management.

makaleler.baslik: PIPAC practice in Spain: a national benchmark defining evidence-driven restraint and a three-phase hypothesis of PIPAC implementation.
makaleler.baslik_tr: İspanya'da PIPAC Uygulamaları Ulusal Kıyaslama Çalışması
makaleler.kisa_ozet: Kırk üç merkezden 32 geçerli merkezin analiz edildiği çalışmada aktif PIPAC programı %34,4 oranında bildirildi. Benimsilmeme nedenleri arasında yetersiz veya sonuçsuz kanıt (%64,3) en sık gösterilen bariyer oldu.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Pressurized intraperitoneal aerosol chemotherapy (PIPAC) has expanded internationally, yet its role remains uncertain due to the lack of high-level evidence and heterogeneous clinical adoption. In this context, national benchmarking is relevant not only for technical standardization but also for governance and patient protection in predominantly palliative settings.
METHODS: We conducted a national, cross-sectional, web-based survey (51 items) among 43 GECOP-affiliated centers (December 2025-March 2026). A total of 32 valid center-level responses were analyzed. Results were summarized descriptively.
RESULTS: Most responding centers were tertiary-level hospitals (78.1%) and public institutions (87.5%), all with established HIPEC programs and extensive experience in peritoneal disease management (81.3% > 10 years). An active PIPAC program was reported by 11/32 centers (34.4%), while 21/32 (65.6%) were not currently performing PIPAC. Among the 14/21 non-adopting centers that provided a reason, the main barrier was insufficient or inconclusive evidence (9/14, 64.3%), followed by organizational and resource constraints and clinical or implementation-related concerns (both 5/14, 35.7%). Only 5/21 centers (23.8%) explicitly reported referral of selected patients to active centers. Among active centers, procedural aspects were highly standardized, including universal adoption of a two-trocar approach (100%), balloon trocars (100%), and systematic safety checklists (90.9%). However, substantial heterogeneity was observed in oncological management, including chemotherapy regimens, dosing strategies, and integration with systemic therapy. The most commonly used regimen was cisplatin-doxorubicin (81.8%), with additional use of oxaliplatin (45.5%), taxanes (18.2%), or mitomycin C (9.1%). Response assessment consistently included peritoneal biopsies and PRGS (100%), frequently combined with PCI (90.9%), but remained heterogeneous in sampling strategies and adjunctive methods. At least one severe complication (Clavien-Dindo ≥3) was reported by 3/11 active centers (27.3%), this represents a center-level report rather than a procedure-level complication rate.
CONCLUSIONS: Within Spanish specialized peritoneal oncology units, PIPAC is implemented in a moderate proportion of centers with insufficient or inconclusive evidence being the most frequently reported barrier among centers providing a reason for non-adoption. Its current use is predominantly palliative, with gastric and colorectal cancer and peritoneal mesothelioma being the most frequently reported indications. It is characterized by marked heterogeneity in indications, treatment strategies, and response evaluation. This variability likely reflects the underlying evidence gap. Rather than discouraging its use, these findings support the need for structured development through prospective clinical trials, centralized data collection, and governance within experienced multidisciplinary teams. These findings allow us to propose a three-phase hypothesis of PIPAC implementation, characterized by initial standardization, subsequent diversification, and current uncertainty-driven practice.

makaleler.baslik: Radical Resection Versus Organ-Preserving Local Excision for Rectal Gastrointestinal Stromal Tumor: The Role of Neoadjuvant Imatinib.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Rektal GIST'te Radikal Rezeksiyon ve Lokal Eksizyon Karşılaştırması
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 128 hastanın incelendiği retrospektif çalışmada, lokal eksizyon (LE) ile total mesorektal eksizyon (TME) arasında 5 yıllık RFS benzer bulunurken (%98,8'e karşı %92,6, p=0,184), 5 yıllık OS LE grubunda daha yüksek saptanmıştır (%96,8'e karşı %92,1, p=0,047). Neoadjuvan imatinib ortalama tümör çapını 64,9 mm'den 49,2 mm'ye düşürmüştür (p<0,001).
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND: Rectal gastrointestinal stromal tumors (GISTs) are rare, and their optimal surgical management remains controversial. This study compared clinicopathologic features and oncologic outcomes between total mesorectal excision (TME) and local excision (LE) to guide surgical strategy.
METHODS: We retrospectively analyzed 128 patients who underwent surgery for rectal GIST at Asan Medical Center between January 2000 and April 2023. Recurrence-free survival (RFS), overall survival (OS), and tumor downsizing were evaluated. Survival was measured from surgery or imatinib initiation in patients receiving neoadjuvant imatinib.
RESULTS: Of 128 patients, 43(33.6%) underwent TME and 85(66.4%) underwent LE. Tumors > 5 cm and neoadjuvant imatinib use were more common with TME, whereas tumors < 2 cm and R0 resection were more frequent with LE. The 5-year RFS did not differ significantly between the LE and TME groups (98.8% vs. 92.6%, p = 0.184), whereas 5-year OS was higher after LE (96.8% vs. 92.1%, p = 0.047). Neoadjuvant imatinib reduced mean tumor diameter from 64.9 ± 23.5 mm to 49.2 ± 19.3 mm (p < 0.001).
CONCLUSION: LE may provide acceptable recurrence control and potential functional advantages in selected patients. For large rectal GISTs, LE may be considered after adequate tumor downsizing with neoadjuvant imatinib.

makaleler.baslik: Wound-Healing Complications Disrupt Early Patient-Reported Recovery After Limb-Sparing Soft Tissue Sarcoma Surgery.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Yara İyileşmesi Komplikasyonlarının Sarkom Cerrahisi Sonrası Toparlanmaya Etkisi
makaleler.kisa_ozet: 74 hastanın incelendiği retrospektif çalışmada, hastaların %60,8'inde yara iyileşmesi sorunu görülmüş ve %21,6'sı reoperasyon gerektiren majör komplikasyon yaşamıştır. Erken dönem yara sorunları ve reoperasyon, 3 ila 6 ay boyunca daha kötü fiziksel ve mental sağlık toparlanma eğrileri ile ilişkilendirilmiştir.
makaleler.ozet:
BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVES: Wound-healing problems, both minor events and major wound-healing complications (WHCs), are common after soft tissue sarcoma (STS) surgery. Their impact on patient-reported recovery remains poorly defined. This study evaluated associations between postoperative WHCs and PROMIS physical and mental health outcomes.
METHODS: We performed a retrospective analysis of a prospectively collected, multi-institutional cohort of adults undergoing limb-sparing resection for extremity or trunk STS (2017-2025). Wound-healing events were recorded, and major WHCs were defined as complications requiring return to the operating room. PROMIS Global Physical Health and Global Mental Health T-scores were obtained preoperatively and at 3 and 6 months. Cross-sectional scores, change from baseline, and responder analyses (≥ 3-point improvement) were compared by WHC status.
RESULTS: Of 74 patients, 45 (60.8%) experienced a wound-healing event and 16 (21.6%) developed a major WHC requiring reoperation. Baseline PROMIS scores were similar between groups. At 3 months, patients with wound-healing events had significantly worse physical and mental health recovery trajectories. Early events and reoperation were associated with worse physical function through 6 months.
CONCLUSIONS: Postoperative wound-healing events, particularly early or major complications, are associated with clinically meaningful disruptions in patient-reported recovery, supporting the value of PROMIS-based postoperative monitoring.

tez.baslik: Deneysel akut peritonit modelinde Chlorella vulgaris ekstraktının antibiyoterapi etkinliği üzerinde etkilerinin araştırılması
tez.baslik_tr: Deneysel Akut Peritonitte Chlorella Vulgaris Ekstraktının Etkileri
tez.kisa_ozet: 35 Wistar albino sıçanla yapılan deneysel çalışmada, CLP ile akut peritonit modeli oluşturulmuştur. Chlorella vulgaris ekstraktının antibiyotikle kombine edildiğinde doku hasarında ve inflamasyonda anlamlı iyileşme sağladığı gösterilmiştir.
tez.ozet: Akut peritonit, yüksek mortalite ve morbidite oranları ile seyreden, acil tedavi gerektiren ciddi bir klinik tablodur. Standart tedavi cerrahi müdahale ve antibiyotik uygulamasını içermekle birlikte, iyileşme sürecini destekleyecek ek ajanlara ihtiyaç duyulmaktadır. Chlorella vulgaris, antioksidan, anti-inflamatuvar ve immünmodülatör özellikleri ile bilinen bir mikroalg olup, enfeksiyon kontrolünde potansiyel faydalar sağlayabileceği düşünülmektedir. Bu çalışmada, deneysel akut peritonit modelinde Chlorella vulgaris ekstraktının antibiyoterapi etkinliği üzerine etkileri araştırılmıştır. Sivas Cumhuriyet Üniversitesi Hayvan Deneyleri Yerel Etik Kurulu onayı ile yürütülen deneyde, 35 adet erişkin ve sağlıklı Wistar albino sıçan kullanılmıştır. Denekler rastgele yedi gruba ayrılmıştır: Sağlıklı kontrol, peritonit kontrol, düşük doz Chlorella vulgaris, yüksek doz Chlorella vulgaris, antibiyotik, antibiyotik + düşük doz Chlorella vulgaris ve antibiyotik + yüksek doz Chlorella vulgaris. Peritonit modeli, cecal ligasyon ve ponksiyon (CLP) yöntemi ile oluşturulmuştur. Antibiyotik tedavisinde seftriakson (30 mg/kg) ve metronidazol (20 mg/kg) intramüsküler olarak uygulanmış; Chlorella vulgaris ekstraktı ise düşük ve yüksek dozlarda oral yolla verilmiştir. Deney sonunda elde edilen periton ve çekum dokuları histopatolojik olarak değerlendirilmiş, peritoneal kalınlık, inflamatuvar hücre infiltrasyonu, neovaskülarizasyon ve hiperemi düzeyleri skorlanmıştır. Peritonit kontrol grubunda belirgin doku hasarı, yoğun inflamasyon ve artmış neovaskülarizasyon gözlenmiştir. Düşük ve yüksek doz Chlorella vulgaris uygulanan gruplarda bu patolojik bulgular kısmen azalmış; antibiyotik ile kombine edildiğinde ise inflamasyon ve doku hasarında anlamlı iyileşme saptanmıştır. En belirgin düzelme, antibiyotik + yüksek doz Chlorella vulgaris grubunda görülmüştür. Sonuç olarak, Chlorella vulgaris ekstraktının akut peritonit tedavisinde inflamasyonu azaltıcı ve antibiyotik etkinliğini artırıcı potansiyele sahip olduğu belirlenmiştir.
